jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:

· Break projects into doable actions and set time-frames

· Liaise with clients to identify and define requirements, scope, and objectives

· Assign tasks to internal teams and assist with schedule management

· Make sure that clients’ needs are met as projects evolve

· Monitor project progress and handle any issues that arise

· Act as the point of contact and communicate project status to all participants

* Health insurance

* Construction: 1 year (Preferred)

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Overview:

As a ***Project Coordinator*** at Schuff Steel, You will assist in managing the flow of technical information between the Schuff Steel Project Management team, customers, and subcontractors and vendors, while developing critical relationships with internal and external clients, through verbal and written communication. They collaborate with other departments to ensure all aspects of each project are executed smoothly. Schuff PC’s have worked on some of the most amazing building structures in North America. Please consider joining our dynamic Project Management Team.

Responsibilities:

**Job Overview**

* Reviews design drawings for accuracy and completeness, and coordinates resolution of discrepancies and/or missing information with customers, design team, other trades, detailing, shop, & field as may be necessary.
* Coordinates project sequencing and basic detailing job setup, including advance bills and shop and erection drawings.
* Provides technical instructions and guidance to steel detailers in preparing shop drawings per project requirements and standards.
* Monitors project schedules regarding submittals, approvals, and shop fabrication releases. Identify and communicate possible delays or problems to project management team.
* Organize detailing RFI process through formal RFI to customer and informal RFI’s with the engineer, architect, and general contractor. Facilitates and fulfills other documentation efforts and duties and as may be required.
* Distribute and route drawings. Partner with Document Control to avoid delays and maintain logs.
* Act as a liaison between shop, field, and detailers to resolve fabrication and erection difficulties.
* Maintains daily communication with Project Manager, Sr. Project Manager or Vice President on progress of areas of responsibility.
* Assists the Project Management Team in achieving successful project results.
* Coordinates the detailing efforts of various common subcontractors.
* Serve as a direct link between Detailers, Project Managers, and other production departments, and customer, other contractors, and Design Team as may be required.

Qualifications:

**Education/Training**

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* Associates degree or training from an approved and accredited technical school in engineering or detailing/drafting is highly preferred.
* A Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university in CM, Structural/Civil Engineering, or other technical area may substitute for required experience.

**Work Experience**

* At least five (5) years related experience in the coordination of structural steel projects. Detailing experience highly preferred.

**Specialized Knowledge**

* Ability to read and interpret shop and design drawings.
* General understanding and knowledge of basic drafting skills
* 3D modeling software/Tekla practices, fabrication and erection standards, standard technical terminology, common structural steel practices, and drafting room procedures.

**Software & Technology**

  

* MS Windows 10, MS Office 365; Office Word, Excel, and Outlook; Contract Manager, Primavera Scheduling, Fabtrol and Tekla system. Bluebeam applications.

**Work Environment**

* The position may require frequent air/road travel as needed and required. A clean driving record will be required due to required road travel.
* A current and valid driver’s license and proof of acceptable insurance is required.
* This position is generally indoors in a climate-controlled office. However, frequent visitations to the outdoor plant facilities and project sites may be required.
* Reasonable accommodations will be made upon request for those who have disabilities that qualify under the American with Disabilities Act.

At Schuff Steel, we believe our employees are our greatest asset. Our team environment is based on respect, effective communications, and accountability. We believe employees should have great working conditions along with opportunities to grow and develop. We proudly promote a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone has a chance to be successful. Schuff Steel is an Equal Opportunity Employer with an Affirmative Action Plan. We value Diversity.

Rated by ENR as a leading builder in America, please consider joining our elite organization today. Apply directly. No agencies #LI-KF1

Pay Range: The anticipated compensation for this position is USD $65,000.00/Yr. - USD $90,000.00/Yr. depending on experience and qualifications.

jobs.title: Concrete Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Concrete Project Coordinator Join Our Team!**
-----------------------------------------------

### **About Us**

Rick Hamm Construction is at the forefront of commercial, industrial, and heavy civil construction projects. With a reputation for excellence, we pride ourselves on quality, precision, and efficiency. We are looking for an experienced Concrete Project Coordinator to be part of our dynamic team.

### **Job Overview**

As a Concrete Project Coordinator, you will play a crucial role in supporting our estimators, superintendents and project management teams to ensure successful planning, execution, and completion of projects. This is a full-time role, but there is a part-time option as well. The position demands someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of multitasking in a fast-paced environment.

### **Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent (Bachelor's degree in construction management or related field is a plus).
* 5 years of experience in concrete construction, preferably in commercial, industrial, or heavy civil projects.
* Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, structural details, and specifications.
* Excellent verbal and written communication abilities.
* Proficiency with construction management software (e.g., Procore, Bluebeam, PlanGrid) and Microsoft Office Suite.
* A proactive and team-oriented mindset.
* Strong organizational, problem-solving, and multitasking skills.
* Meticulous and detail-oriented, with a proven ability to ensure accuracy, thoroughness, and consistency.
* Must be available to work in the office daily.

### **Responsibilities**

* Organize and maintain accurate project records and documentation related to concrete activities.
* Support the project team with coordination, scheduling and communication with vendors, subcontractors, and clients.
* Assist the project team with the organization of On-Screen Takeoff and project management software.
* Support the project team in responding to and sending out RFPs and RFQs.
* Conduct site visits and capture photographs as required for project documentation and progress tracking.
* Prepare and manage RFIs, submittals, and change orders related to the concrete scope of work.
* Work closely with field crews to resolve technical or constructability issues promptly.
* Participate in project meetings with clients, design teams, and subcontractors to provide updates on concrete operations.
* Provide general administrative support to ensure the project runs smoothly.

### **What We Offer**

* Pay Range: $70,000/year.
* Full-Time Position (Part-Time optional).
* Working Hours: 6:00 AM - 3:00 PM (with 30 min lunch).
* Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, Retirement Savings.

### **Join Us**

If you have the expertise and passion for construction, especially in concrete project coordination, we would love to hear from you! Apply today and be a part of our journey in building excellence.

jobs.title: Youth Alumni Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Program: Workforce Development

Department: Youth Services

Reports to: Sr. Program Manager, Workforce Development

Status: 100%, Full-Time, Non Exempt

Probation: 90 days

Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision; also including Life Insurance, Long-Term Disability, Employee Assistance Program, and a 403(b) Retirement Plan

Center’s Mission:

Building a world where LGBT people thrive as healthy, equal, and complete members of society.

**DEPARTMENT SUMMARY:**The Youth Center serves youth up to the age of 24 who are currently at-risk of or experiencing homelessness. The Youth Center offers services in an LGBTQ+ safe and affirming environment and serves as an entry point to assist youth making the transition from homelessness to housing. Our services include meals, clothing, support groups, a charter high school, GED and college prep program, employment preparation, training and placement program, case management, counseling, a crisis shelter and a transitional living program (TLP). Our community-based programs include services for youth at home, in school, or in systems of care.

**JOB SUMMARY**: As an integral part of the Workforce Development team, the Youth Alumni Program Coordinator coordinates retention strategies that transition participants from vocational training into active alumni engagement. This role collaborates across departments to support youth aging out of programs, provides supportive services and mentorship coordination, and strengthens long-term participant stability. This position tracks alumni outcomes, manages data and reporting requirements, oversees alumni communications and events, and ensures continuous program evaluation and improvement to meet organizational and funder goals.

**ESSENTIAL****FUNCTIONS**

**% of Role**

25

**Program Coordination & Strategy**

* Coordinate and implement a comprehensive retention strategy that transitions vocational training participants into alumni status
* Lead a peer mentorship program connecting alumni with current youth participants
* Evaluate alumni program initiatives and events, identifying successes, challenges, and recommendations for improvement
* Support strategic development of the aged-out system to ensure continuity of services for youth transitioning from all department programs

35

**Participant Engagement & Support Services**

* Partner with Workforce Development team coordinate and strengthen participant engagement and retention
* Provide appointment-based supportive services to alumni and connect them to appropriate community resources
* Partner with the Mentoring Navigator to ensure all alumni are matched with mentors
* Build rapport with participants to promote progression from program enrollment to active alumni involvement

10

**Data Management & Reporting**

* Maintain and coordinate alumni database systems in partnership with Youth Academy and IT teams to ensure accurate tracking of youth transitions
* Track and report on alumni outcomes related to housing, employment, health, and overall stability
* Prepare monthly and funder-required reports detailing alumni program performance
* Collect, analyze, and distribute program evaluations to leadership, staff, and the Steering Committee

10

**Event Coordination**

* Plan and coordinate alumni events, collaborating with task force as necessary
* Ensure events align with program goals and participant engagement strategies
* Provide regular updates to leadership on alumni engagement and event outcomes

20

**Administrative & Operational Support**

* Regularly communicate with alumni via email to ensure they are receiving updates, resources, and support
* Maintain organized program documentation and records
* Support cross-departmental collaboration to ensure smooth program operations
* Perform additional duties as assigned to meet organizational and funder requirements

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Knowledge of or experience working with the LGBTQ community and familiarity with issues of particular relevance to LGBTQ people
* A passion for the Center’s work and its mission to make the world a better place for LGBTQ people
* Minimum 2 years’ experience in program development, volunteer management and working with at-risk youth
* Experience in psychology, sociology or related field or bachelor’s degree
* Working knowledge of the Los Angeles County network of social services
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills
* Proficiency with Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and databases
* Sensitivity to and appreciation of the needs and challenges of gay, lesbian, transgender, bisexual and questioning youth and other marginalized and at-risk youth
* Ability to work effectively and collegially with people of diverse education levels, abilities, races, ethnicities, spiritual affiliations, gender identities, ages and sexual orientations
* Available to work a flexible schedule that includes weekends and evenings
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with people of diverse races, ethnicities, nationalities, sexual orientations, gender identities, gender expression, socio-economic backgrounds, religions, ages, English-speaking abilities, immigration status, and physical abilities in a multicultural environment

The Los Angeles LGBT Center is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering diversity within its staff. Applications are encouraged from all persons regardless of their race, color, ancestry, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, sex, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, religion, disability, age, military or veteran status, including status as a victim of domestic violence, assault or stalking, genetic information (including family medical history), political affiliation or activities, medical or health conditions, and marital status.

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description:**Innovative Dining Group (IDG) is seeking a detail-oriented and creative MARKETING COORDINATOR** **to support marketing initiatives across our growing portfolio of restaurants.**

This hands-on role will help keep our digital presence accurate and up to date, support social media and content development, conduct competitive and industry research, and assist with restaurant-level marketing needs. The ideal candidate is curious, organized, resourceful, and excited to learn, with a strong interest in hospitality, marketing, social media, and emerging technology.

**This position is based full-time in our corporate office located at 9200 Sunset Blvd., West Hollywood, CA 90069.**

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES** include but are not limited to:

**Digital + Website**

* Conduct regular audits of all brand and restaurant websites to ensure hours, menus, reservation links, contact information, private dining details, photography, and copy are accurate and up to date.
* Audit Google Business Profiles for accuracy, including hours, categories, links, photos, menus, and other key business information.
* Ensure restaurant names and business information are consistent across Google, Apple Maps, Yelp, Tripadvisor, and other relevant platforms.
* Conduct regular Yelp and Tripadvisor audits to identify inaccurate information, outdated imagery, or other content requiring updates.
* Test SevenRooms reservation links across websites, social media, Google, and other customer-facing channels to ensure links are active and functioning properly.
* Review the mobile experience across all websites and flag formatting, functionality, or content issues.
* Set up and maintain enterprise Canva accounts across locations and provide basic training and support to GMs as needed.
* Audit restaurant menus across digital channels to ensure they accurately match current approved menu PDFs.
* Audit email signup forms across all websites to ensure they are functioning properly and capturing customer information as intended.

**Social Media**

* Conduct regular social media audits to ensure account information, links, contact details, and other profile information are accurate and up to date.
* Monitor Instagram and TikTok for trending sounds, formats, and content opportunities relevant to BOA, Sushi Roku, Katana, and other IDG brands.
* Identify and organize relevant user-generated content, including screenshots and creator handles, for potential reposting by individual restaurant locations.
* Research emerging restaurant content trends and formats and present 5–10 relevant content ideas each week.

**Restaurant + Operations Marketing**

* Maintain an accurate inventory of restaurant uniforms, including updating tracking spreadsheets and organizing uniform storage areas.
* Develop and maintain a master reference of restaurant hours, happy hours, brunch and lunch offerings, private dining capacities, parking and valet information, and other key guest-facing details.
* Assist Marketing Manager with planning, production, organization, and coordination of the Holiday Cookbook.
* Support restaurant-level marketing needs and projects as assigned, helping ensure brand standards and marketing materials are consistently executed across locations.

**Competitive Research + Industry Trends**

* Conduct ongoing competitive research using Bluenote and other relevant sources to identify trends and opportunities across the restaurant and hospitality industry.
* Monitor competitors and relevant brands for new restaurant openings, launches, collaborations, events, promotions, partnerships, and creative marketing initiatives.
* Prepare a weekly Friday recap highlighting the most relevant trends, ideas, and competitive activity for the marketing team.

**Technology + AI**

* Research emerging marketing technology, AI tools, platforms, and resources that could improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the Marketing department.
* Assist in auditing recurring marketing tasks and workflows to identify redundancies, opportunities for automation, and areas where AI can improve efficiency.
* Research and recommend AI tools that can support creative production, reporting, PR and copywriting, content development, and project management.
* Help establish and maintain approved AI tools, prompts, standard operating procedures, and training resources for the Marketing department.
* Evaluate tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Munch, and other emerging platforms for potential use in marketing campaigns, content creation, reporting, and workflow automation.
* Assist Marketing Manager in improving visibility and organization of social media content planning and execution at the restaurant level.

Requirements:

**QUALIFICATIONS**:

* 1–2 years of marketing, communications, social media, or related experience preferred; internships and relevant college experience welcome.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field preferred.
* Strong interest in hospitality, restaurants, social media, and digital marketing.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable learning new technology and digital platforms; Canva experience preferred.
* Creative, curious, and proactive, with a willingness to learn and bring new ideas to the team.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
* Willingness to travel to IDG restaurants and support projects in the field as needed.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

**MANAGER, STARLINK CUSTOMER SUCCESS (ASIA-PACIFIC & OCEANIA)**

Starlink provides high-speed, low-latency internet to customers around the world. Our enterprise resellers bring Starlink to businesses across a wide range of markets and use cases.

As the **Manager, Starlink Customer Success (Asia-Pacific & Oceania),** you will lead the team responsible for our enterprise reseller business across Asia-Pacific, including Australia, New Zealand, and the Pacific Islands. The region spans a broad set of countries, time zones, regulatory environments, and customer needs, with resellers often operating across multiple markets. You will manage Customer Success Managers, Leads, and Specialists and be accountable for the performance and growth of the existing book.

Your team is responsible for growing revenue with existing customers, expanding their use of Starlink, and maintaining strong commercial relationships. Across Asia-Pacific and Oceania, turning an opportunity into revenue can depend on product availability, capacity, local billing requirements, regulatory readiness, logistics, and activation. You will help the team navigate those constraints while keeping the focus on growth.

This is a player-coach role. You will set clear priorities, coach and develop your team, and hold a high bar for performance. You will also stay close to key customers and step into the most important growth opportunities, renewals, payment issues, and escalations. We expect you to know your book, understand where the next opportunities and risks are, and keep a geographically distributed team focused on the right work.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead, hire, and develop a team of Customer Success Managers, Leads, and Specialists across Asia-Pacific and Oceania
* Grow revenue across an existing book of enterprise resellers
* Help the team identify and close opportunities for customers to expand their use of Starlink across hardware, service, data, and products
* Build hardware and service forecasts that leadership can rely on, with a clear view of opportunities and risks across markets
* Develop a clear view of where demand is growing across the region and what is required to turn that demand into revenue
* Work through billing, payment, regulatory, capacity, logistics, product availability, and activation issues when they are blocking growth
* Partner with Sales, Channel Sales, Finance, Tax, Engineering, Operations, Support, and Logistics to move customer opportunities forward
* Align closely with regional Sales and Channel Sales teams so resellers receive a clear and consistent message across markets
* Identify problems that repeat across countries and work with the right teams to solve them at scale
* Build strong coverage and operating discipline across a team working with customers in widely separated time zones
* Stay close enough to the work to know when to coach, when to step in, and when to let the team run independently

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
* 6+ years in customer success, account management, sales, or another commercial role for a technical product
* 3+ years owning and growing a book of existing customers, with direct responsibility for revenue, retention, or expansion
* 2+ years of direct people management
* Experience managing enterprise customers across multiple countries or markets

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**

* Strong track record of growing revenue within existing enterprise accounts
* Experience leading a commercial book across Asia-Pacific and Oceania
* Experience managing customers across geographically distributed markets with different regulatory, billing, logistics, and product requirements
* Commercial mindset with the ability to understand a customer's business, find opportunities, and turn them into revenue
* Experience leading geographically distributed teams responsible for customer and revenue goals

* Experience in telecommunications, satellite, connectivity, networking, or another technical industry

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Must be willing to travel regularly throughout Asia-Pacific and Oceania and to other SpaceX locations

* Develop a clear view of where the largest opportunities and risks are across the region and focus the team accordingly
* Work through local billing, tax, payment, regulatory, capacity, logistics, and activation issues when they are blocking revenue
* Partner with Sales, Channel Sales, Finance, Tax, Engineering, Operations, Support, and Logistics to move customer opportunities forward

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience

We’re looking for a hands-on marketer to own organic social media and community events for our Healthcare vertical. You’ll work across two brands: HealthStaff Training Institute (HSTI), which prepares students for careers in healthcare, and KMK Optometry, which prepares optometry students for their board exams. **Content Capture**

* Coordinate photo and video shoots at campuses and events, and gather student testimonials, success stories, and milestone moments

**Community Events & Brand Representation**

* Build and manage the HSTi events calendar: career fairs, community and workforce events

* Experience in education, healthcare, or career training is a plus

* A portfolio of social content and event work to share during the interview process
* Scrappy, self-starting, entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable building from the ground up and wearing many hats

**Why You’ll Love It Here**

* **Mission with Meaning –** Your work empowers learners to achieve real career outcomes.
* **Room to Run –** Operate with startup agility, backed by long-term investor support.
* **Ownership Mentality –** Build and lead a high-impact function from day one with autonomy and visibility.
* **Collaborative Culture –** You’ll be part of a passionate, fun, and high-performing team that values doing good work and enjoying the process.

Pay: $72,000.00 - $78,000.00 per year

**Benefits:**

* Health insurance
* Opportunity for advancement
* Parental leave
* Profit sharing
* Training & development
* Vision insurance
* Wellness resources
* 401(k)

**Fortune Electric America Inc. (FEA)**, a U.S. subsidiary of Fortune Electric Co., Ltd., a publicly traded company headquartered in Taiwan, is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented **Logistics Coordinator Assistant** to join our growing team.

This is a great opportunity for someone interested in building a career in **logistics, transportation, and supply chain operations**. You will work closely with our Logistics team to coordinate the transportation and delivery of **large power transformers** and related equipment throughout the United States.

**Prior logistics experience is preferred but not required. We are willing to provide hands-on training to a motivated candidate with strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.** This position also offers opportunities to develop into a **Logistics Coordinator** role as you gain experience.

What You'll Do

* Coordinate with our overseas teams to obtain transformer dimensions, weights, shipping schedules, and other transportation requirements.
* Work with freight forwarders, trucking companies, and third-party logistics (3PL) providers to obtain and review transportation quotes.
* Prepare freight cost comparisons and recommendations for management review and approval.
* Coordinate and track shipments from origin through final delivery, ensuring schedules and delivery requirements are clearly communicated.
* Provide timely shipment updates to Sales, Service, Job Site Managers, Accounting, customers, and other internal teams.
* Communicate directly with carriers and logistics vendors to address shipment delays, scheduling changes, oversized-load requirements, and other transportation issues.
* Work closely with headquarters, vendors, and internal teams to identify practical and cost-effective shipping solutions and help minimize additional freight and overage charges.
* Coordinate delivery appointments with customers, job sites, carriers, and internal teams and confirm successful completion of deliveries.
* Review freight documentation and submit invoices to Accounting for processing and approval.
* Maintain organized and accurate shipment records, quotes, delivery documentation, and logistics files.
Provide day-to-day administrative and operational support to the Logistics team and assist with special projects as needed.  

What We're Looking For

* Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred; equivalent education or relevant work experience will also be considered.
* Logistics, transportation, supply chain, freight, or coordination experience is a plus, but not required.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly **Excel, Outlook, and Word**.
* Strong numerical and analytical skills with the ability to compare costs and review shipping information accurately.
* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple shipments and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable communicating with vendors, carriers, customers, and internal teams.
* Proactive problem-solving skills and willingness to take ownership of assigned tasks.
Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively as part of a team.  

Why Join Fortune Electric America?

✅ **Hands-on training provided** – grow your logistics knowledge and experience  
✅ **Career growth opportunity** toward a Logistics Coordinator role  
✅ **Competitive base salary + months of bonus opportunities**  
✅ **Comprehensive benefits**, including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), employer-paid Basic Life Insurance, and employer profit-sharing opportunities  
✅ **Generous PTO program + paid company holidays**  
✅ Work directly with domestic and international teams on large-scale transportation and infrastructure projects  
✅ Supportive and collaborative work environment with opportunities to learn and grow

If you're organized, dependable, comfortable working with numbers, and interested in developing a career in logistics and supply chain operations, **we'd love to hear from you.**

Thank you for considering a career with Fortune Electric America. We look forward to receiving your application!

Why Work With Us?

The Warehouse & Purchasing Coordinator is responsible for end-to-end warehouse operations, including receiving, shipping, inventory control, fleet coordination, and maintaining a safe, efficient facility. This role also manages procurement and RMA processes, ensuring timely and cost-effective sourcing of materials and equipment to support business needs. The ideal candidate has proven experience in warehouse and purchasing operations, with strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to drive improvements independently.​
  
  
Essential Functions
  

* Perform and coordinate daily warehouse activities, including receiving, inventory handling, material staging, and outbound distribution to support project and service operations.
* Maintain a clean, organized facility while ensuring consistent application of safety standards and regulatory compliance
* Track inventory movement and accuracy, performing physical counts, and reconciling discrepancies with system data
* Handle fleet coordination, including routine maintenance scheduling and vehicle utilization.
* Collaborate with operations and back-office teams to evaluate vendors and procure materials, equipment, and vehicles.
* Execute purchasing decisions in collaboration with other departments for stock and project-specific items, guiding inventory additions/deletions based on business needs.
* Manage the return goods (RMA) process, ensuring timely resolution, minimized return costs, and proper vendor credit.
* Address warehouse issues or incidents directly, documenting root causes and implementing corrective actions.
* Occasionally deliver or transport materials and equipment to job sites when needed.
* Conduct scheduled physical inventories to ensure accurate reconciliation to maintain inventory integrity.
* Promote and maintain high safety standards across warehouse and logistics operations.
* Provide light facilities support as needed to maintain a safe and functional workplace.
* Perform additional responsibilities as assigned by the management team.

Minimum Qualifications
  

* High School Diploma or GED required
* Minimum 3 years of warehouse management experience
* Knowledge of physical security systems, network devices
* Experience in purchasing and procurement of warehouse-related materials is a plus
* Ability to lift over 50 pounds and work comfortably on ladders and lifts
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a strong focus on delivering exceptional service
* Proficient with basic hand and power tools, and knowledgeable in electrical circuitry and blueprint reading
* Current and valid US driver’s license

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  

* ​​Self-motivated; able to work with minimal supervision
* ​Strong computer skills including Microsoft Office products
* ​Ability to think independently
* ​Good communication skills, written and verbal​

Physical Demands
  
​​Spends more than 2/3 of time standing, kneeling/crouching/stooping, using hands and reaching. Spends approximately 1/3 of time walking and talking/hearing. Frequent lifting required of items 25-50 pounds, and occasional lifting over 50 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.​
  
  
Work Environment
  
​​Conditions will include proximity to forklifts or other heavy machinery and using various tools and hardware. Subject to frequent heavy lifting. May require driving to project sites. May be exposed to variable weather conditions, including hot and cold temperatures.​
  
  
Qualification Requirements
  
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator (Center for Neurobehavioral Genetics)
jobs.description:
**Description**

The UCLA Semel Institute for Neuroscience and Human Behavior is seeking a Clinical Research Coordinator to support a growing portfolio of research studies focused on identifying the genetic and biological factors that contribute to psychiatric and neurological disorders. The Center for Neurobehavioral Genetics conducts innovative research aimed at advancing the understanding, prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of brain and behavioral health conditions through multidisciplinary scientific collaboration.

In this role, you will coordinate clinical research activities across UCLA and collaborating domestic and international sites, support research data and biospecimen management, maintain study databases, and contribute to a variety of scientific and administrative research activities.

Key Responsibilities

* Coordinate day-to-day operations for multiple clinical research studies and collaborating sites.
* Develop and maintain REDCap databases and study documentation, including user access, data dictionaries, validation rules, and project workflows.
* Monitor data quality, perform validation reviews, conduct data reconciliation activities, and prepare research datasets and reports.
* Support biospecimen tracking, sample quality control, repository submissions, and reconciliation of collection and shipment records.
* Assist with regulatory documentation, IRB submissions, protocol compliance activities, and study reporting requirements.
* Coordinate meetings, communications, and project deliverables with investigators, research staff, and domestic and international collaborators.
* Support preparation of grants, manuscripts, presentations, scientific reports, and other research materials.
* Learn and support specialized research systems and platforms, including REDCap, BTM, Azure, and repository-submission systems.

Salary range: $38.19/hr - $61.45/hr

  
Pay range: $38.19 - $61.45 an hour  
  
**Qualifications**  
Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Neuroscience, Public Health, Biological Sciences, Health Sciences, Data Science, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum two years of experience supporting clinical or human-subjects research.
* Experience with REDCap or similar electronic data capture systems, including project development, data dictionary creation, validation rules, database maintenance, user permissions, and data exports.
* Strong data management skills, including data cleaning, validation, quality control, reconciliation, and preparation of analysis-ready datasets.
* Working knowledge of human subjects research, research compliance requirements, confidentiality standards, and data security practices.
* Familiarity with basic programming/coding in R and/or Python.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
* Ability to learn and support specialized research systems and platforms.
* Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a fast-paced research environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with investigators, research staff, technical teams, and external partners.

Preferred Qualifications

* Graduate-level training in a scientific, public health, clinical research, quantitative, or related field.
* Experience supporting multi-site, international, biospecimen-based, or repository-related research studies.
* Experience preparing scientific reports, presentations, grant materials, manuscripts, or other scholarly work.
* Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills.

jobs.title: Assistant EB Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Careers feel different when the culture actually means something.  
At The Liberty Company, our people-first approach has earned us multiple years of recognition as a top insurance employer—and it shows in how we work every day. We value fresh ideas, teamwork, and taking care of the people who make our success possible. Along with an award-winning culture, we offer competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, generous PTO and holidays, continued education, and wellness-focused programs designed to help you bring your best self to work. If you’re ready to grow with a company that truly invests in its people, you’re in the right place. We're looking for an up and coming Assistant Employee Benefits Operations Coordinator to join our growing team!

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Assistant EB Operations Coordinator supports the day-to-day operational engine of the Employee Benefits practice. This role is a hands-on driver behind carrier appointments, carrier access and logins, signature and legal routing, and the daily task flow that keeps Account Management and Sales teams moving without friction.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Carrier Appointments & Contracting**

* Submit, track, and drive carrier appointment and contracting requests through written confirmation, researching unfamiliar carriers and agencies to identify requirements and contacts as needed
* Maintain the tracker daily so status is current without being asked; follow up on a set cadence and escalate stalls
* Gather and submit required documentation (licensing, W-9s, E&O, ACH, agency information) accurately and completely the first time, and confirm effective dates, writing numbers, and agency codes once received

**Carrier Access, Logins & Portal Support**

* Process carrier portal access and login requests for producers, account managers, and service staff, troubleshooting issues (locked accounts, permissions, expired credentials) until resolved
* Maintain accurate records of carrier portal access by user and office
* Support access setup and removal during onboarding/offboarding with the EB Operations Manager, IT, and HR

**Legal & Signature Coordination**

* Submit carrier agreements and appointment paperwork to Legal for review and signature with complete context and clear deadlines, tracking documents through to return of fully executed copies to the carrier
* Maintain organized, retrievable records of executed agreements and keep requesters informed on status without them having to ask

**Daily Operations & Task Follow-Through**

* Monitor shared mailboxes and the request queue; triage and respond within turnaround standards, owning tickets end to end and closing them only once resolved
* Support routine system/account setup and data entry as directed; maintain checklists and documentation for the processes this role runs, and flag recurring issues or process gaps to the EB Operations Manager with suggested fixes

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Communication**

* Partner with Account Management, Sales, Legal, Accounting, IT, and HR to move requests forward and remove operational roadblocks
* Communicate status proactively and in writing - what is done, pending, blocked, and needed
* Draft and publish operational updates in Workvivo (appointments, access changes, deadlines) in a clear, on-brand voice
* Support the EB Operations team on partnership onboarding and book rolls, and participate in special projects as assigned

**Execution Expectations**

* Own outcomes, not activity. A task is complete when the result is confirmed - not when the request is sent
* Follow up persistently and professionally. Most carrier and vendor items require multiple touches; build the cadence and hold it
* Escalate early, with a recommendation rather than only a problem
* Document as you go so any teammate can pick up an open item without a verbal handoff
* Ask questions when unsure; do not guess on items affecting carrier relationships, compensation, or compliance
* Manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment and communicate early when timelines are at risk
* Maintain accuracy, organization, and confidentiality across all work

**Competencies**

* To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies: Ownership, Persistence, Follow-Through, Resourcefulness, Organization, Attention to Detail, Written and Verbal Communication, Collaboration, Professionalism, Adaptability, Initiative, and Relationship Building.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Must-Haves**

* 1+ year of experience in employee benefits, insurance operations, carrier relations, licensing/appointments, or a similar operational role preferred
* Highly resourceful and self-directed, with the ability to research unfamiliar carriers, identify requirements, and independently drive the appointment process through to completion
* Strong sense of ownership and follow-through
* Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage a high volume of appointments and requests
* Detail-oriented and process-minded
* Comfortable working through ambiguity and troubleshooting issues without requiring step-by-step direction
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the judgment to escalate appropriately when progress stalls
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, with the ability to quickly learn agency management systems, SharePoint, carrier portals, and workflow systems
* Discretion in handling confidential information

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Direct experience submitting or managing carrier appointments, contracting, or producer licensing
* Exposure to agency management or benefits administration systems (e.g., BenefitPoint, AMS360, Employee Navigator, Ease)
* Experience with a ticketing or workflow system (e.g., Monday.com or similar)
* Experience coordinating documents for legal review and signature
* Experience posting to an internal communications platform (e.g., Workvivo)
* Active Life & Health insurance license, or willingness to obtain one

jobs.description:
**Org Marketing Statement**

At Parker Aerospace, we develop technologies and innovative solutions that enable reliable, efficient and increasingly sustainable flight for the lifecycle of the aircraft, including aftermarket support. Our passionate people with deep engineering expertise, together with our breadth of differentiated technologies, ensure that we make the extraordinary happen and continue to shape the future of aviation in partnership with our customers.

As a member of our team, you are instrumental in fulfilling our mission: 'Enabling Engineering Breakthroughs that Lead to a Better Tomorrow.' Pursuing a career at Parker presents unlimited opportunities for both professional and personal development. Working with some of the most brilliant minds in the industry, your contributions will be pivotal in developing innovative technologies and products, significantly contributing to Parker’s goal of addressing the world’s most pressing engineering challenges. At Parker, our team members belong, matter and make a difference.

**Services & Support Operations Division**

The Services and Support Operations (SSO) is a global leader of integrated MRO services and support. We are renowned for our exceptional customer service and expertise at every stage of the aircraft lifecycle, providing innovative OEM-quality service solutions across a comprehensive portfolio. We are proud to serve airlines/ business jet operators, the military, airframe/ engine manufacturers, as well as independent service centers. With our extensive network of service teams worldwide, MRO facilities, proprietary predictive modeling, and advanced systems, we offer 24/7 operational and technical support wherever it's needed.

**Account Manager (SSO – Location: Irvine, CA)**

**Position Summary**

Manages and executes all sales activities and contracted bookings for Premier and Strategic customer accounts. Partners with internal SSO and division teams to improve customer scorecard performance and increase LTR. Identifies growth opportunities across major programs, product lines, and market segments within the division, while supporting the execution of awarded business negotiated by Business Development Managers within the territory. Performs root cause analysis for underperforming spare parts and MRO components and develops, coordinates, and implements corrective action plans to improve performance.

**Scope/Supervision and Interaction:**

\_\_\_\_ Has Direct Reports \_\_X\_\_ Does Not Have Direct Reports

Provides leadership for an aftermarket business segment; is the primary contact for assigned customers of moderate complexity and scope. May provide guidance and assign work to other Parker employees (e.g. administrators, technicians or engineers). Coordination may cross multiple sites and divisions. Has regular interaction with customers and Division leadership. Typically reports to division staff or an aftermarket business development manager.

**Essential Functions:**

* Acts as primary interface with customers by maintaining on-site presence and developing and maintaining on-going, long-term relationships at all levels of the customer’s organization with a focus on Premier and Strategic customer base.
* Serves as the customer’s advocate within Parker by acting as the liaison and facilitator for the resolution of issues regarding any aspect of Parker support. Identifies technical, logistical, performance, or support issues with Parker products or services.
* Ensures long-term profitable growth of spares, repairs, product improvements, and retrofit business of all Parker Aerospace product lines at assigned customers by working with Aftermarket Business Development Managers to develop and implement marketing plans and strategies.
* Identify new business opportunities through working the closure of major customer issues
* Responsible for meeting sales and contracted bookings targets for portfolio of customers identified by Manager. Capable of obtaining customer intel/forecasts and translating that into division specific action plans as it relates to FY plan and outlook
* Owns customer scorecard performance metrics (delivery TAT, quality / quarantined events, warranty adjudication, reliability, customer service) and partners with the service centers, CRC, spares - surplus, reliability, customer service engineering, field service, and divisions to maintain a high level of operational performance.
* Performs root cause analysis for underperforming spare parts and MRO components and develops, coordinates, and implements and maintains corrective action plans to improve performance
* Provides contractual performance auditing to confirm adherence of key contractual terms such as pricing / exclusivity vs actual events.
* Serves as customer expert and resource – i.e. “owns” the VOC to SSO and Divisions.
* Complies with federal, state, and aerospace industry regulations by studying existing and new legislation, enforcing adherence to requirements, and advising management on needed actions (e.g. export compliance).
* Coordinates the completion of administration tasks of discounts, royalties, rebates, remedies, and CY escalation.
* Responsible for leading F2F customer reviews. Prepares all presentations needed for F2F reviews by partnering with technical / service center teams.
* Coordinates the development and population of Plan for Every Customer “PFEC” alongside Business Development Manager.
* Maintains professional and technical knowledge by attending seminars, reviewing trade and technical publications, establishing networks, and/or participating in professional associations.

**Qualifications:**

Bachelors degree (BA) in Marketing, Engineering, or related field. Demonstrated ability to perform the essential functions of the job typically acquired through eight or more years of increasingly responsible experience, including two or more years of high-level program management or prior customer account management experience

jobs.title: [MARKETING] Digital Marketing Manager, Brand Experience and Demand Generation
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**
---------------------

The Digital Marketing Manager (Brand Experience & Demand Generation) plays a critical role at the intersection of Brand, Media, and Digital Commerce. This position is responsible for driving high-quality consumer demand and shaping the digital brand experience across key touchpoints, ensuring that awareness and consideration efforts translate into measurable business impact.

Acting as a strategic bridge between Brand Marketing, eCommerce, and Media teams, this role focuses on building and activating upper- and mid-funnel strategies that generate qualified traffic and accelerate the path to purchase. The position owns paid media strategy, website experience (TCL.com), and CRM-driven lifecycle marketing to ensure a cohesive and effective consumer journey from discovery through purchase intent.

The successful candidate brings a strong understanding of how modern digital marketing ecosystems operate, with the ability to translate brand and commercial objectives into integrated campaigns, content strategies, and data-driven optimizations that deliver results.

This role is ideal for a marketing professional who is equally comfortable managing media investments and performance metrics as they are shaping digital experiences, content strategies, and consumer journeys.

**Duties & Responsibilities:**
------------------------------

**Paid Media Strategy & Demand Generation**

* Develop and execute upper- and mid-funnel paid media strategies across Video, Social, Display, and Native channels to drive qualified traffic and build consumer consideration.
* Design and implement innovative media approaches that shorten the path from product discovery to purchase, accelerating the "see-to-buy" cycle.
* Build and refine audience segmentation strategies to effectively engage consumers early in the decision-making process and nurture future conversion.
* Own media execution, including budget allocation, performance optimization, and traffic quality, ensuring efficient use of investment aligned with business priorities.

**Website Experience & Content Strategy (TCL.com)**

* Own TCL.com as the central hub for brand storytelling, product education, and consumer engagement-not just as a transactional platform.
* Design and optimize end-to-end user journeys that drive engagement and increase purchase intent through intuitive navigation and compelling content.
* Lead SEO and organic growth initiatives by improving site structure and developing high-quality content (e.g., product pages, guides, editorial content) aligned with consumer research behavior.
* Implement traffic routing strategies that align with business goals, optimizing pathways to retail partners or direct purchase flows as needed.

**CRM & Lifecycle Marketing**

* Develop and manage CRM and email marketing strategies to capture and nurture upper-funnel demand into qualified purchase intent.
* Drive first-party data acquisition through targeted campaigns and on-site lead capture strategies, strengthening direct consumer engagement channels.
* Optimize lifecycle communications to improve engagement, retention, and readiness to convert.

**Analytics, Insights & Performance Optimization**

* Analyze performance across channels with a holistic view, focusing on traffic quality, engagement, and contribution to downstream conversion-not just last-click sales.
* Develop and refine attribution approaches to better understand the impact of upper- and mid-funnel efforts on total business performance (DTC and retail).
* Translate data insights into actionable recommendations to continuously optimize media mix, content strategy, and user experience.

**Business Impact & KPI Ownership**

* Define and track key performance indicators including traffic growth, engagement, SEO visibility, media efficiency, and CRM database expansion.
* Drive measurable improvements in qualified traffic, purchase intent signals, and marketing efficiency through disciplined execution and optimization.
* Promote a data-driven, test-and-learn culture to continuously refine strategies and maximize return on marketing investment.

These duties are directly related to essential operations, safety, trust, and compliance obligations within our organization. Please note that job duties may evolve based on business needs and additional responsibilities may be assigned as necessary to maintain operational efficiency and security.

**Physical and Work Environment Requirements:**
-----------------------------------------------

* This is an on-site position based in Irvine, CA. Regular in-person attendance is an essential function of the role.
* Frequent use of typical office equipments such as keyboard, screens, and monitors. Extended periods of sitting, standing, and moving around the office.
* Occasional travel may be required to support business needs.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

**Must Have:**

* 5–10 years of experience in digital marketing, paid media, demand generation, or related roles.
* Proven ability to manage and optimize multi-channel paid media campaigns with a focus on upper- and mid-funnel performance.
* Strong understanding of digital consumer journeys, including content strategy, SEO, and lifecycle marketing.
* Hands-on experience with analytics tools and the ability to translate data into actionable insights and business recommendations.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across brand, eCommerce, and analytics teams.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience managing or optimizing brand websites and content hubs.
* Familiarity with CRM platforms and email marketing tools.
* Exposure to multi-channel retail environments (DTC + retail partners).
* Strong analytical mindset with experience in attribution modeling or marketing mix analysis.
* Background in consumer electronics, retail, or high-consideration purchase categories.

**Benefits:**
-------------

* Vacation: Starting at 5 days per year

**“See It and Be It” Program Coordinator (Richmond Area)**

**STEAM the Streets | Part-Time Contract | 8-15 hours/week | November–March | $30/hour**

**About STEAM the Streets**

STEAM the Streets is a mission-driven organization that uses media, music, arts, and STEAM education to connect young people to careers and inspire them to see new possibilities for their futures.

**About the Role**

STEAM the Streets is seeking a highly organized, proactive **See It and Be It Richmond Area Program Coordinator** to support the delivery of our **See It and Be It** program with our partners at West Contra Costa Unified School District (WCCUSD) Department of College and Career.

This is a **part-time, project-based contract role** responsible for coordinating logistics, communication, and school-site readiness across four participating middle schools. The coordinator will help ensure that the program is organized and ready from initial school coordination through the February assembly week and early curriculum implementation.

The ideal candidate is organized, responsive, comfortable communicating with school staff, and able to manage multiple moving pieces with minimal supervision.

**About the See It and Be It Program**

**See It and Be It** is a career exploration program from STEAM the Streets that introduces middle school students to a range of STEAM careers through engaging classroom curriculum and real-world exposure. The program kicks off with our **“This Can Be You”** career exploration assemblies, followed by classroom-based career exploration that helps students discover new possibilities and pathways for their future.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Program Preparation & Coordination – November–January**

* Onboard with STEAM the Streets and review existing commitments, timelines, contacts, forms, and planning materials for the four participating schools.
* Establish and maintain communication with school administrators and teachers at each site.
* Schedule planning meetings and coordinate follow-up with each school.
* Coordinate deadlines and readiness activities leading up to the February assemblies.
* Ensure January deadlines are met for assembly forms, school site visits, technical checks, schedules, and final confirmations.
* Conduct site visits to assess assembly spaces and document logistics, including room setup, AV/technical needs, parking/loading, student capacity, and arrival procedures.
* Coordinate technical checks and communicate site-specific needs to the STEAM the Streets team.
* Maintain a master schedule and program logistics tracker for all four schools.
* Coordinate catering and materials for the professional development/training session.
* Support preparation and on-site logistics for the December train-the-trainer session for approximately 8–12 WCCUSD educators.
* Coordinate pre-program survey follow-up with participating teachers, ensuring teachers understand their role in distributing and completing student pre-surveys.

**This Can Be You Assembly Week – February 8-12**The coordinator will serve as the primary on-the-ground logistics support for STEAM the Streets during assembly week, ensuring each school is prepared and the team has what it needs to successfully deliver the assemblies.

Responsibilities include:

* Confirm final details with each school prior to arrival.
* Coordinate arrival times and access with school staff and the STEAM the Streets team.
* Ensure spaces, equipment, materials, and other site requirements are ready before each assembly.
* Help coordinate setup and troubleshoot logistical or technical issues that arise.
* Serve as the on-site point person for school logistics and communicate issues to the Founder / CEO as needed.
* Assist with breakdown and ensure materials and equipment are accounted for following each assembly.
* Complete daily follow-up and flag any outstanding issues or changes.

**Program Implementation – March**

* Maintain light-touch communication with participating educators as curriculum implementation begins.
* Follow up with teachers regarding student surveys and other program information.
* Conduct occasional school-site check-ins as needed.
* Track questions, issues, and follow-up items and escalate anything requiring STEAM the Streets leadership.
* Assist with collecting program feedback and basic participation information.

**Ideal Candidate**

* Highly organized and detail-oriented.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable communicating with school administrators, teachers, and education professionals.
* Reliable, responsive, and able to manage deadlines independently.
* Comfortable working on-site at schools and during program events.
* Able to anticipate logistical needs and troubleshoot problems calmly.
* Experience in education, youth programs, events, or nonprofit program coordination is a plus.
* Familiarity with WCCUSD or Richmond-area schools is helpful but not required.

**Contract Details**

**Position:** See It and Be It Richmond Area Program Coordinator**Type:** Part-Time Contract**Term:** November–March**Hours:** 8–15 hours per week, with a spike in hours during the February 8–12 assembly week**Rate:** $30/hour**Location:** Richmond area / Hybrid, with required in-person work at district and school sites during program activities**Reports to:** Founder / CEO, STEAM the Streets

**What Success Looks Like**

The coordinator keeps the **See It and Be It** program moving and makes sure each school is prepared, informed, and ready. By the time the STEAM the Streets team arrives at a school, the logistics should be confirmed, the site should be ready, and any potential issues should already be identified and communicated.

**Success means:**

* Each school is informed, prepared, and ready for its scheduled program activities.
* Assembly logistics are confirmed in advance, potential issues are identified early, and each assembly runs smoothly from arrival through breakdown.

Each year, more than 40,000 people in the U.S. leave home and never make it back due to traffic crashes. At Obvio, we believe these deaths are preventable. We deploy solar-powered, AI-assisted cameras to enforce traffic laws where pedestrians are most vulnerable, automating enforcement in ways that traditional systems cannot. We are seeking a high-agency, hands-on Events & Field Marketing Manager to build and lead our field presence from the ground up. In this role, you will own how Obvio shows up in the physical world: from public safety trade shows and municipal conferences to intimate roundtables with local officials, police chiefs, city planners, and enterprise partners.

You will bridge offline experiences with sales pipeline, brand building, and community engagement. You will evaluate where Obvio invests, design high-impact activations that stand out, negotiate contracts, and oversee end-to-end technical and physical execution on-site.

### **What You'll Do**

* Lead the strategy, planning, and execution of Obvio’s field marketing calendar, directly aligning event strategy with GTM revenue targets and geographical expansion goals.
* Evaluate, prioritize, and secure Obvio’s presence at major government expos, public safety summits, traffic safety conferences, and industry trade shows.

* Partner with Sales and Government Relations on target account strategy, pre-event outreach, on-site meeting schedules, and post-event lead routing.
* Collaborate cross-functionally to create event-specific toolkits, localized marketing collateral, and interactive hardware demonstrations.
* Establish event KPIs, track lead attribution and deliver clear post-event performance reporting to GTM leadership.
* Build repeatable, scalable field playbooks to support rapid company growth across new markets.
* Identify and secure high-impact speaking opportunities, panels, and media engagements for company executives, building credibility and positioning the company as a recognized authority in the market.

**Who We Are:**  
Our story began in 2011 when a group of office workers at a major logistics company in Chicago had a lunch problem. Nearby options were limited, and the team was spending too much time and money traveling to their favorite restaurants. They had an idea: bring Chicago’s local restaurant culture inside the office to sell food. It was an immediate hit. When they discovered people from other companies sneaking into their office, they knew they were on to something.  
  
Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities with over 100 million meals served and continue to grow rapidly.  
  
Powered by technology and a network of 3,500+ restaurants, we feed hungry people at work through a platform of unique food programs located within companies, office buildings, hospitals, schools, distribution centers, and more. At Fooda, we believe a workplace food program should be something employees love and look forward to every day.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Support Fooda events in a variety of capacities, including: being onsite to set-up, tear down, clean equipment and site areas, problem-solve, and ensure high quality set-up and customer experience
* Gain competency with Fooda’s technology and standard operations procedures
* Problem-solve for issues such as incorrect orders, late deliveries, late restaurant arrivals, or incorrect email communication
* Troubleshoot technical issues with point-of-sale (POS) system, onsite technology, and TV menu boards
* Conduct onsite Fooda promotions and mobile app coaching
* Provide real-time onsite customer service to resolve issues promptly directly with the consumer
* Facilitate audits of restaurant event set-up to ensure consistency and high quality
* Escalate issues to Operations Manager when necessary to keep them informed or help problem solve
* Critical hours are over lunch we have positions available Monday - Friday (10 am – 2 pm) but responsibilities may span 8am-4pm, depending on the market and need

**Who You Are:**

* You love building relationships with customers and enjoy customer service
* You are friendly, high energy and love interacting with other people
* You are savvy with technology and will be comfortable in a fast-paced start-up
* You are resourceful, exhibit grace under pressure, and know you’re capable of finding solutions
* You are a strong communicator and self-starter
* You are organized and detail oriented. Type-A personality is a plus!
* You’re someone who knows the local territory and gets around efficiently in your own car
* You’re looking for a steady part-time job (between 5 - 25 hours per week) during regular business hours and value flexibility
* Prior catering or serving experience strongly preferred

 **Benefits**

**What We’ll Hook You Up With:**

* Competitive wages: $22-$23/hr based on experience level

jobs.title: Manager, Technical Account Management
jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

Cyberhaven is looking for a Manager, Technical Account Management to build and lead the team of Technical Account Managers who own the technical relationship with our customers. Your team is accountable for how each customer deploys, adopts, and gets value from Cyberhaven's Agentic Data Security platform, from onboarding through renewal. You will hire and develop the team, define how TAMs work with accounts, and make sure customers get a consistent, proactive technical partner and experience.

You are a people leader with a technical background in security SaaS and endpoint agents, and you are comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where the team's processes are still being written. You will coach TAMs on and step in on critical escalations when needed. You will also work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Support Engineering, Customer Experience, and Sales to turn what the team learns from customers into improvements to the product and to how we serve customers.

Technical depth, a strong client focus, and experience leading customer-facing technical teams are required. You will report to the VP of Support and Technical Account Management.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Lead and grow the team**

* Hire, onboard, and develop Technical Account Managers. Set clear expectations, give regular feedback, and run career development and performance reviews.
* Coach TAMs on account strategy, technical troubleshooting, executive communication, and managing difficult customer situations.
* Build a team culture of growth mindset, ownership, curiosity, and accountability for customer outcomes.
* Plan headcount and coverage as the customer base grows, including how accounts are assigned and balanced across the team.

### **Define how the TAM function operates**

* Establish the TAM operating model: account segmentation, coverage, engagement cadence, business review format, and technical success plans.
* Set the team's goals and metrics, such as account health, agent coverage and deployment progress, adoption, escalation volume and time to resolution, and customer satisfaction. Report on them to leadership.
* Create and maintain playbooks, runbooks, and knowledge base standards so TAMs handle common situations the same way.
* Define the handoffs between TAMs and Customer Experience and Sales so customers always know who owns what.

### **Own customer outcomes**

* Review account health across the team's book of business and step in early on accounts at risk of low adoption, deployment problems, or churn.
* Act as the senior escalation point for critical customer issues. Make sure TAMs bring clear reproductions and context to Engineering, and that customers stay informed through resolution.
* Build relationships with customes, and join executive and business reviews for strategic accounts.
* Work with Customer Success and Sales on renewals, expansions, and risk mitigation, providing technical input and account insight.

### **Be the voice of the customer**

* Collect customer feedback, feature requests, and recurring issues from the team and bring them to Product Management and Engineering with the technical and business context behind them.
* Work with Engineering and Support Engineering to improve diagnostics, debugging tools, and escalation processes.
* Run root cause analysis reviews on significant incidents and drive preventive follow-ups so issues do not repeat.
* Stay current on industry trends, security best practices, and adjacent technologies such as SIEM, SOAR, and UEBA, and bring them into the team's guidance to customers.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 3+ years of experience managing a team of Technical Account Managers, Support Engineers, Solutions Engineers, or similar customer-facing technical staff.
* 7+ years in customer-facing technical roles.
* Track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong technical people, and of handling performance issues directly and fairly.
* Experience building or scaling a TAM, Support, or Customer Success function, including processes, playbooks, and metrics.
* Demonstrated ability to own customer technical outcomes from implementation through steady-state operation, and to understand a customer's architecture and environment end-to-end.
* Hands-on experience deploying, supporting, and troubleshooting SaaS-based security and/or endpoint agent technologies.
* Proven experience managing escalated technical customer issues and working directly with engineering teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills (English), including the ability to engage both hands-on practitioners and executive stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, set timelines, and track progress across a team and its accounts.
* Practical knowledge of networking, security products, enterprise network infrastructure, and Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoint management (SCCM, GPO, Intune, MDM, and application management).
* Ability to read and interpret logs and diagnostic output across Windows, macOS, Linux, and Google Kubernetes Engine well enough to coach others and guide technical investigations.

### **Desired**

* Familiarity with adjacent technologies that Cyberhaven integrates with (SIEM, SOAR, UEBA).
* Expertise with DLP, Insider Threat, and CASB solutions.
* Prior experience leading a TAM team at a security or SaaS company.
* Experience working in an early-stage or high-growth company where the team's processes were still being defined.
* Background in L2/L3 or Escalation Engineering for EDR or DLP tools.

Joining Cyberhaven means joining the team building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise. Traditional tools fall short. Cyberhaven traces the full lifecycle of your data, adapting protection to changing context, so protection moves with the way people actually work, not against it. AI Changed Work. We Protect It.

jobs.title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Hi, We're AppFolio**
----------------------

We're innovators, changemakers, and collaborators. We're more than a software company. We're pioneers in cloud and AI who deliver magical experiences that make our customers' lives easier. We're revolutionizing how people do business in the real estate industry, and we want your ideas, enthusiasm, and passion to help us keep innovating.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a **Strategic Customer Success Manager (SCSM)** in AppFolio's Revenue Organization, you'll own the success of a portfolio of our largest, most valuable accounts. You'll be the trusted advisor to sophisticated operators. You'll build relationships at every level, from owners and VPs to day-to-day teams. You'll use your industry knowledge to help customers get measurable results from the AppFolio Real Estate Performance Management (RPM) platform.

You'll bring the right resources in at the right moment in the customer journey so customers reach their evolving business goals. You'll partner closely with a Technical Account Manager (TAM) and the rest of your account pod to design solutions around each customer's challenges.

**Your Impact**
---------------

### **Retention and risk mitigation**

* Protect and grow long-term revenue by positioning AppFolio as a strategic partner and showing continuous, measurable platform ROI.
* Spot churn signals early through health-score monitoring, then run data-driven plans to protect at-risk revenue.
* Forecast renewals and analyze past churn to sharpen your account-health strategy.

### **Adoption and usage**

* Educate customers on underused features and best practices that fit their business model.
* Use platform usage data to find gaps and deliver targeted training to key stakeholders.
* Map platform capabilities to customer workflows so they get full value against their goals.

### **Growth and expansion**

* Identify and qualify expansion opportunities, including add-on products and service-tier upgrades.
* Pass insights and qualified leads from your customer relationships to Sales and Growth teams.
* Map white space within existing accounts to uncover new revenue potential.

### **Stakeholder relationships and success planning**

* Build strong relationships with senior decision-makers (VPs, Directors, Owners) across your portfolio.
* Translate customer business goals into technology-driven strategies on the AppFolio platform.
* Create and own Joint Success Plans that tie AppFolio adoption to goals like increasing NOI or reducing operational overhead.
* Lead Business Reviews (QBRs/EBRs) focused on ROI, value realized, and progress toward goals.
* Support executive-alignment efforts on your most strategic accounts with senior CSMs and leadership.

### **Renewal and lifecycle management**

* Recommend subscription tiers (Core, Plus, Max) that match each customer's unit-growth path.
* Manage renewal timing and lifecycle milestones across your portfolio.
* Find and nurture reference customers for testimonials and case studies, working with Marketing and Sales.

### **Cross-functional collaboration**

* Partner with TAMs to design and implement solutions for specific client challenges.
* Advocate for customers by relaying product feedback to the right teams and helping shape roadmap priorities.
* Work with your account pod (GAEs, TAMs, Product Managers) to coordinate delivery and value.
* Stay current on industry trends and the AppFolio platform, and add to the team's knowledge base.

**How We Define Success**
-------------------------

* Strong gross and net revenue retention across your Strategic portfolio
* Completed Business Reviews and active relationships with key stakeholders
* Portfolio expansion through tier upgrades, V+ services, and cross-sell leads
* Early risk identification and measurable gains in platform adoption
* Growing customer advocacy by building engaged reference customers who contribute to testimonials, case studies, and other advocacy activities

**What You Bring**
------------------

* **Leadership:** Strong business acumen and credibility as an industry expert and trusted advisor to executives. You lead and work well with cross-functional teams.
* **Influence:** You persuade and negotiate at every level to reach win-win outcomes, and you build consensus across different perspectives.
* **Analytical rigor:** You use data to make decisions and build buy-in. You can size up a situation, define objectives, and recommend a plan.
* **Organization:** Excellent project management and organizational skills.
* **Creative problem solving:** You connect client needs to what AppFolio can do. You're entrepreneurial, a proactive learner, and at home in a fast-paced environment.
* **Communication:** Excellent written and verbal skills. You're a natural presenter and storyteller.
* **Customer focus:** A client-first mindset and a drive to exceed expectations.

**Must Have**
-------------

* 6-8 years in customer success, account management, sales, or a related role, preferably in Enterprise SaaS or the property management industry
* Proven record of managing, growing, and retaining strategic, relationship-driven accounts and influencing senior stakeholders
* Ability to work both collaboratively and independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
* Proficiency with Customer Success platforms (e.g., Vitally), CRM (Salesforce), and Google Suite
