jobs.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
**Overview**

**Gotham Studios**, an Emmy Award-winning creative production company, is expanding into integrated marketing and seeking an experienced digital marketing specialist to join our team on a part-time basis.

Our initial focus is performing arts organizations in the San Francisco Bay Area, with the opportunity to grow alongside Gotham's developing marketing practice.

We're looking for someone who knows how to take excellent creative material—videos, photography, graphics, and compelling copy—and turn it into effective digital marketing campaigns that build audiences, generate engagement, and sell tickets.

What you'll do

* **Social media:** Manage and schedule posts across Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and potentially TikTok, adapting content for each platform.
* **Audience targeting:** Identify and reach potential new audiences, including younger arts and music enthusiasts, using organic and paid digital marketing.
* **Digital advertising:** Plan and manage modest Meta and Google advertising campaigns, monitor performance, and optimize results.
* **Email marketing:** Prepare and distribute promotional campaigns, manage mailing lists, and develop effective audience segmentation.
* **Website:** Maintain and update promotional content, optimize event pages, and coordinate basic search-engine optimization.
* **Analytics:** Track engagement, website traffic, email performance, advertising results, and ticket-sale conversions where data is available.
* **Campaign coordination:** Maintain a marketing calendar, manage deadlines, and help ensure that campaigns are executed consistently and on time.
* **Client communication:** Participate in occasional planning meetings and represent Gotham Studios professionally.

You'll work directly with Gotham's founder and creative director, who will lead campaign concepts, copywriting, graphic design, and video production.

What we're looking for

* At least 2–3 years of practical digital marketing experience, including hands-on campaign execution.
* Proficiency with Meta Business Suite, digital advertising tools, email marketing platforms, and basic analytics.
* Experience targeting audiences and evaluating campaign effectiveness.
* Familiarity with website content management and practical SEO.
* Strong organizational skills, responsiveness, and the ability to work independently.
* Excellent communication skills and confidence participating in client meetings.

Experience marketing performing arts, music, cultural organizations, or nonprofits is highly desirable.

Basic video production skills are welcome but **not required**. Gotham handles professional video production in-house.

The arrangement

* **Hours:** Approximately 4–6 hours weekly to start, with additional hours during active concert campaigns, by mutual agreement.
* **Location:** Remote, with a preference for San Francisco Bay Area candidates who know the local arts market.
* **Compensation:** Anticipated range of $40–$60 per hour, depending on qualifications and agreed responsibilities.
* **Start:** As soon as practicable following confirmation of our initial client engagement.
* **Status:** This is an anticipated opportunity, contingent upon finalization of a client contract. Employment classification and contractual terms will be confirmed before engagement.

The right person will have an opportunity to become a valued part of Gotham's expanding marketing practice, work directly with clients, and help shape how we bring exceptional creative work to new audiences.

How to apply

Please send the following to **jobs@gothamstudios.com**:

* A résumé or LinkedIn profile.
* A brief description of relevant campaigns you've managed.
* Examples of work, preferably with measurable results.
* Your hourly rate and approximate availability.

We're particularly interested in candidates who combine creative judgment with technical competence, independence, and a genuine enthusiasm for the performing arts.

Pay: $40.00 - $60.00 per hour

Expected hours: 4.0 – 8.0 per week

Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Francisco, CA 94115

jobs.title: Inventory & Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

We are hiring a junior Inventory & Logistics Coordinator in Fremont, CA to maintain accurate inventory, organize stock, coordinate inbound and outbound product movement, and support international and RMA shipments. We design, build, and assemble our devices in-house. This position serves as the operational link between physical inventory, logistics, and the Purchasing department.

The primary focus is inventory control, stock management, and logistics execution. Purchasing is a collaborative support function: this role will communicate stock levels, reorder needs, shipment status, receiving discrepancies, and demand information so Purchasing can make timely buying decisions and prevent stockouts or excess inventory.

**Primary Responsibilities**

*Inventory Control & Stock Management*

* Maintain accurate inventory records in the inventory and ERP platform, ensuring system quantities align with physical stock.
* Count, verify, and document incoming materials, finished products, outgoing shipments, returns, and replacement units.
* Perform routine cycle counts and periodic physical inventory checks; investigate and resolve discrepancies, missing items, and transaction errors.
* Receive parts and materials, complete quality checks for damage or defects, and document vendor or shipment issues.
* Label, organize, and store inventory with clear item identification, location control, and separation of new and existing stock.
* Maintain minimum and safety-stock thresholds for parts, consumables, finished products, repair supplies, and replacement materials.
* Monitor inventory usage and stock movement to identify low-stock, slow-moving, or excess items and recommend appropriate action.
* Organize and maintain both the in-house storage area and offsite storage facility for efficient retrieval and accurate stock visibility.
* Prepare monthly and quarterly inventory reports for Finance and provide inventory status updates to Operations and Purchasing.

*Logistics, Shipping & Receiving*

* Coordinate domestic and international inbound and outbound shipments, including seasonal increases during Q2 and Q4.
* Prepare commercial invoices, packing lists, Certificates of Origin, and other required customs documentation.
* Assign appropriate Harmonized System (HS) codes and support accurate duty, tax, tariff, and landed-cost calculations.
* Coordinate with FedEx, DHL, UPS, USPS, and ShipStation to schedule, track, and troubleshoot shipments.
* Apply Incoterms and destination-country requirements to support compliant international delivery.
* Monitor shipment status, delivery timing, damages, shortages, and carrier exceptions; communicate delays and resolve issues promptly.
* Coordinate RMA repair and replacement shipments, ensuring stock records, customs documents, and delivery details are accurate.
* Package and ship individual devices and kits and, when required, deliver packages to local carrier locations.
* Identify opportunities to reduce freight and total landed costs while maintaining service and compliance.

*Purchasing Department Collaboration*

* Provide Purchasing with accurate stock balances, reorder-point alerts, open shipment status, and anticipated material needs.
* Collaborate with Purchasing to convert approved replenishment needs into timely purchase orders and follow through on delivery status.
* Support material requirements planning (MRP) by sharing inventory usage, stock availability, lead-time concerns, and demand information.
* Track purchase orders in the ERP system and coordinate expediting when materials are at risk of stockout or production delay.
* Reconcile received quantities against purchase orders and packing documents; communicate shortages, overages, damages, and invoice discrepancies.
* Partner with Purchasing and Engineering on occasional sourcing needs, vendor information, and part substitutions.
* Support supplier performance tracking by documenting on-time delivery, quality issues, and recurring receiving discrepancies.
* Coordinate with Purchasing, Finance, Sales, Operations, and warehouse stakeholders to align material availability with business priorities.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* 1+ years of experience in inventory control, stock management, logistics, shipping and receiving, or supply chain operations; 2-3+ years of combined inventory and logistics experience is strongly preferred.
* Hands-on experience maintaining inventory accuracy, managing stock locations, completing counts, and resolving discrepancies.
* Understanding of purchasing workflows, purchase orders, reorder points, lead times, and supplier coordination.
* International shipping or customs documentation experience is preferred.
* Manufacturing operations exposure is a plus.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel is required, along with comfort using Microsoft Office 365.
* Experience with ERP or inventory management systems; Confluence, ShipStation, and FedEx tools are a plus.
* Strong attention to detail, math, organization, documentation, and record-keeping skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and communicate clearly across Purchasing, Operations, Finance, and Engineering.
* Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs; most individual shipments weigh approximately 5-10 lbs.
* Reliable transportation for occasional package drop-offs at USPS, FedEx, or UPS locations.
* Able to work in-office Monday-Friday in Fremont, CA.

Pay: $20.00 - $26.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

**What you will do**

* Own the Job Schedule calendar: enter every booked job with client, address, contacts, scope, crew count, trucks and equipment
* Build and send bills of lading, crew call sheets and client confirmations before each job
* Collect and reconcile daily time sheets against the schedule; flag gaps and overtime before payroll
* Request and track certificates of insurance, elevator reservations and dock windows with building management
* Keep job folders current: proposals, estimates, floor plans, photos, sign-offs, damage reports
* Be the first-line contact for clients on logistics questions once a job is booked
* Track scope changes and open items on live jobs so nothing is missed at billing
* Support the Operations Manager and Project Manager with proposal prep, site walk notes and meeting follow-ups
* Help with field recruiting paperwork: onboarding, certifications, availability

**What we are looking for**

* 2+ years in a coordinator, scheduler, office or admin role at a moving, logistics, construction, facilities or furniture company
* Detail obsessed; you notice a wrong suite number before anyone else does
* Fast and tidy in Google Workspace (Calendar, Sheets, Docs) and comfortable learning QuickBooks, CompanyCam and HubSpot
* Writes a clean, short email
* Calm on the phone with clients, building staff and crew
* Nice to have: experience with COIs and building logistics in Manhattan, Spanish, interest in moving into project management

**Pay and benefits**

* $52,000 to $65,000 a year, based on experience
* Health and dental insurance
* Paid time off and holidays
* Hybrid after six months

**Babyface Brows | Park Slope, Brooklyn**  
**Part-Time | 15–25 hours/week | $20–$24/hour**

**IMPORTANT: Applications must be submitted online through this posting. Please do not call or visit the studio about the position. Applicants who call or visit in person to apply will not be considered.** If your background looks like a good fit, we’ll contact you directly.

Join Babyface Brows

Babyface Brows is a specialty brow and lash studio in Park Slope, Brooklyn, just steps from Barclays Center. We’re building a beauty brand around expert brows, great lashes, and a thoughtful client experience.

We’re looking for a creative, self-motivated person who can help us make better content, connect with our audience, and grow our presence online.

Your Focus

You’ll help shape how people discover and experience Babyface online. Working directly with management, you’ll turn ideas into content for Instagram, TikTok, and other social platforms.

This is a hands-on creative role to start, with room to take on greater responsibility across marketing as the business grows.

Show Us What You Can Create

**Previous content creation experience is required.** You don’t need to have worked for a company or agency. Content from your own social accounts, school projects, freelance work, personal projects, or a business all count. We want to see that you’ve taken an idea and turned it into something people can watch, read, or engage with.

Day-to-Day ResponsibilitiesCreate, Film & Publish

You’ll help bring a mix of content to life, including:

* Before-and-after transformations
* Educational posts and carousel graphics
* Short-form videos, including Reels, TikToks, skits, and trends
* Stories and interactive content
* Behind-the-scenes footage and everyday studio moments
* New creative concepts that fit our brand and audience

You’ll also be responsible for:

* Researching trends and developing fresh content ideas
* Planning shoots and coordinating with clients and artists
* Filming services, transformations, and team moments
* Helping people feel comfortable and natural on camera
* Editing content using CapCut, Canva, or similar tools
* Preparing and publishing posts across our social channels
* Maintaining a consistent posting schedule and visual style

How You’ll Grow in the Role

Initially, you’ll partner closely with management to produce more content, strengthen its quality, and test new creative approaches.

Over time, we want you to take greater ownership of the process, from planning the content calendar to organizing shoots, editing, publishing, and reviewing performance.

The goal is to build someone who can independently manage day-to-day social content and contribute ideas that help the business grow.

Beyond Social Media

As Babyface expands, this position has the potential to develop into a broader marketing role. Depending on your interests and performance, future responsibilities may include:

* Email campaigns and client communications
* Neighborhood partnerships and community marketing
* Influencer outreach and brand collaborations
* Meta and Google advertising
* Marketing campaigns and promotional materials
* Client surveys, audience segmentation, and performance analysis
* Helping develop and eventually lead a wider marketing function

We’re looking for someone who wants to develop their skills and take on more as the business grows.

The Person We’re Looking For

Professional experience is less important than creativity, initiative, sound judgment, and a willingness to learn.

You’ll be a strong fit if you’re:

* Constantly coming up with new ideas
* Comfortable making short-form videos
* Willing to film and guide people on camera
* Organized and able to manage multiple tasks
* Comfortable working independently and taking initiative
* Familiar with CapCut, Canva, or comparable creative tools
* Interested in beauty, fashion, lifestyle, or digital media
* Curious, adaptable, and willing to experiment

*If you spot a trend and immediately start thinking about how Babyface could put its own spin on it, we’d love to hear from you.*

Pay & Perks

* Flexible scheduling
* Employee discount

* Potential to take on additional hours and expanded responsibilities over time

How to Stand Out

Include a link to your portfolio or a piece of content you’re proud of in your application. It can be an Instagram account, Reel, TikTok, video, campaign, or personal project. We’re interested in your ideas and execution, not just your résumé.

**Job type:** 40 hrs/week

Get Better Transportation is hiring a field sales representative to build relationships with dialysis centers, hospitals, and cancer centers across New York. No healthcare sales experience needed. We will train you. If you are sharp, learn fast, and enjoy talking with people, this is a great first step into healthcare business development.

**About Us**

Get Better Transportation is a New York City-based non-emergency medical transportation company committed to getting patients where they need to go reliably, safely, and on time. We serve hospitals, oncology centers, dialysis clinics, and specialty medical facilities across the five boroughs and Long Island, connecting patients with the care they need every day. * Build and maintain relationships with contacts at each facility

* A strong communicator who is confident starting conversations with people you have never met

* Experience in sales, customer service, outreach, healthcare, or transportation is a plus, not a requirement. Internships, part-time jobs, and campus involvement all count.

* Hourly pay plus a potential for performance bonus
* Training provided, and real responsibility from the start
* A strong reference and room to grow

The Ecommerce Account Manager is responsible for managing the day-to-day activities, support needs, and growth opportunities for a portfolio of wholesale and marketplace ecommerce accounts. * Monitor account performance and identify opportunities to improve sales, product visibility, and overall business growth.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, reps, and key stakeholders.
* Act as the main point of contact for Codarus representatives and the AS ISR team and/or Marketplace account managers regarding ecommerce account information and support.
* Prepare and distribute reports, sales updates, product information, and other requested business insights.
* Coordinate new product launches, assortment updates, pricing changes, and content updates across assigned accounts.
* Ensure account data and product information remain accurate and up to date across customer platforms.
* Escalate and help resolve customer issues, content discrepancies, and operational challenges.
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, Operations, and Product teams to support customer needs and business objectives.

**You Have**

* Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting tools.

* Benefits package offered to all eligible full-time employees (including medical, dental, vision, PTO, 401(k)

75,000 - 90,000 USD per year(Manhattan Office)

jobs.title: Enterprise Technical Account Manager, AMER
jobs.description:
**ABOUT TALON.ONE:**

  

Talon.One is the most powerful incentives engine that unifies loyalty, promotions and gamification into one holistic platform. Backed by enterprise-grade security and scalability, Talon.One empowers companies to build personalized, profitable promotions and loyalty programs using any data.

Today, over 250 of the world's most-loved brands including Adidas, Sephora and Carlsberg work with Talon.One to drive deeper engagement and lasting loyalty with their customers.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

Join our team as an Enterprise Technical Account Manager at Talon.One, where you'll play a key role in driving the success of our API-first promotion engine for our enterprise clients across the growing Americas region. You'll take ownership of the technical integration process, ensuring our platform fits seamlessly into each client's ecosystem. As the technical lead for your portfolio, you'll proactively monitor API usage, resolve recurring issues, and manage escalations in close collaboration with our Engineering and Customer Success teams.

You'll lead onboarding design, manage expectations, and deliver consistent value that boosts retention, growth, and satisfaction. In this strategic role, you'll also explore new tech partnerships and integration opportunities that expand our ecosystem and unlock more value for our customers.

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM:**

Our global team of 15+ Technical Account Managers is spread across the world, including EMEA, US, and APAC. We always strive for a seamless client onboarding and bug-free integration, while balancing ever-changing client requests on a daily basis. Our team works closely with Customer Success Managers and the development team, enabling us to act as consultants to all parties involved in the client onboarding journey. Ultimately, handling expectations related to the integration of our platform is where we drive value for our clients & our company.

Our team is defined by our commitment to mutual support and our dedication to deep problem-solving. These qualities are essential in future teammates in order for us to continue building on our strengths.

The estimated total compensation for this role is $115,500, though actual compensation may vary depending on factors such as relevant experience, skills, qualifications, certifications, and location. The salary range is subject to change and may be adjusted at any time. For this role, you must be located within commuting distance of one of our US hubs: New York, Chicago, San Francisco, or Boston.

  

**ONCE YOU ARE HERE YOU WILL:**

* Own the end-to-end technical integration of our API-driven platform into each client's ecosystem
* Troubleshoot recurring technical issues and drive escalations through to resolution
* Manage a portfolio of enterprise accounts, tracking API usage to protect retention, growth, and satisfaction
* Partner with Customer Success Managers and Engineering to deliver a strong client experience
* Design and continuously improve customer onboarding processes
* Identify new technology partnerships and integration opportunities that expand our ecosystem
* Guide customers through expectation-setting conversations that build long-term trust
* Support escalated tickets alongside the broader support team

  

**WHAT WE NEED YOU TO BRING TO THE TABLE:**

* 4+ years of previous experience working as a Technical Account Manager, Integrations Consultant, , or similar technical client-facing role
* Experience owning API integrations end-to-end for enterprise-level accounts
* Demonstrated ability to successfully handle the demands of Enterprise accounts, including complex stakeholder management
* Proven experience with SaaS based products
* High level of problem-solving attitude in a troubleshooting environment
* Excellent written communication skills with the ability to explain complex topics in easily understood and concise language to both technical and non-technical professionals
* Stay calm, patient, and professional while managing high-stakes customer relationships
* Analytical understanding with a high focus on data-driven decision-making

  

**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Learning budget and LinkedIn Learning
* Competitive salaries & 401(k) plan w/match
* Medical, dental, & life insurance
* Flexible PTO
* Mental health support with Nilo.health

jobs.title: Manager, Technical Account Management
jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

Cyberhaven is looking for a Manager, Technical Account Management to build and lead the team of Technical Account Managers who own the technical relationship with our customers. Your team is accountable for how each customer deploys, adopts, and gets value from Cyberhaven's Agentic Data Security platform, from onboarding through renewal. You will hire and develop the team, define how TAMs work with accounts, and make sure customers get a consistent, proactive technical partner and experience.

You are a people leader with a technical background in security SaaS and endpoint agents, and you are comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where the team's processes are still being written. You will coach TAMs on and step in on critical escalations when needed. You will also work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Support Engineering, Customer Experience, and Sales to turn what the team learns from customers into improvements to the product and to how we serve customers.

Technical depth, a strong client focus, and experience leading customer-facing technical teams are required. You will report to the VP of Support and Technical Account Management.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Lead and grow the team**

* Hire, onboard, and develop Technical Account Managers. Set clear expectations, give regular feedback, and run career development and performance reviews.
* Coach TAMs on account strategy, technical troubleshooting, executive communication, and managing difficult customer situations.
* Build a team culture of growth mindset, ownership, curiosity, and accountability for customer outcomes.
* Plan headcount and coverage as the customer base grows, including how accounts are assigned and balanced across the team.

### **Define how the TAM function operates**

* Establish the TAM operating model: account segmentation, coverage, engagement cadence, business review format, and technical success plans.
* Set the team's goals and metrics, such as account health, agent coverage and deployment progress, adoption, escalation volume and time to resolution, and customer satisfaction. Report on them to leadership.
* Create and maintain playbooks, runbooks, and knowledge base standards so TAMs handle common situations the same way.
* Define the handoffs between TAMs and Customer Experience and Sales so customers always know who owns what.

### **Own customer outcomes**

* Review account health across the team's book of business and step in early on accounts at risk of low adoption, deployment problems, or churn.
* Act as the senior escalation point for critical customer issues. Make sure TAMs bring clear reproductions and context to Engineering, and that customers stay informed through resolution.
* Build relationships with customes, and join executive and business reviews for strategic accounts.
* Work with Customer Success and Sales on renewals, expansions, and risk mitigation, providing technical input and account insight.

### **Be the voice of the customer**

* Collect customer feedback, feature requests, and recurring issues from the team and bring them to Product Management and Engineering with the technical and business context behind them.
* Work with Engineering and Support Engineering to improve diagnostics, debugging tools, and escalation processes.
* Run root cause analysis reviews on significant incidents and drive preventive follow-ups so issues do not repeat.
* Stay current on industry trends, security best practices, and adjacent technologies such as SIEM, SOAR, and UEBA, and bring them into the team's guidance to customers.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 3+ years of experience managing a team of Technical Account Managers, Support Engineers, Solutions Engineers, or similar customer-facing technical staff.
* 7+ years in customer-facing technical roles.
* Track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong technical people, and of handling performance issues directly and fairly.
* Experience building or scaling a TAM, Support, or Customer Success function, including processes, playbooks, and metrics.
* Demonstrated ability to own customer technical outcomes from implementation through steady-state operation, and to understand a customer's architecture and environment end-to-end.
* Hands-on experience deploying, supporting, and troubleshooting SaaS-based security and/or endpoint agent technologies.
* Proven experience managing escalated technical customer issues and working directly with engineering teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills (English), including the ability to engage both hands-on practitioners and executive stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, set timelines, and track progress across a team and its accounts.
* Practical knowledge of networking, security products, enterprise network infrastructure, and Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoint management (SCCM, GPO, Intune, MDM, and application management).
* Ability to read and interpret logs and diagnostic output across Windows, macOS, Linux, and Google Kubernetes Engine well enough to coach others and guide technical investigations.

### **Desired**

* Familiarity with adjacent technologies that Cyberhaven integrates with (SIEM, SOAR, UEBA).
* Expertise with DLP, Insider Threat, and CASB solutions.
* Prior experience leading a TAM team at a security or SaaS company.
* Experience working in an early-stage or high-growth company where the team's processes were still being defined.
* Background in L2/L3 or Escalation Engineering for EDR or DLP tools.

Joining Cyberhaven means joining the team building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise. Traditional tools fall short. Cyberhaven traces the full lifecycle of your data, adapting protection to changing context, so protection moves with the way people actually work, not against it. AI Changed Work. We Protect It.

**About Ramp**
==============

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

As a Strategic Account Manager, you will be responsible for driving the strategy, growth, and overall health of a book of 8–12 of Ramp’s largest and most strategic customers. You’ll own the long-term relationship and be accountable for maintaining and growing revenue, driving product adoption, and ensuring your customers achieve meaningful business outcomes on Ramp.

* Own end-to-end execution of renewals and expansions, from discovery and solution design through commercial negotiation and close

**About the Role**
------------------

Cyberhaven is looking for a Technical Account Manager to be the technical quarterback for our customers. You will own the full technical picture of each account: how Cyberhaven is architected and deployed, how it integrates with the customer's environment, how it is performing, and whether it is delivering the outcomes the customer bought it for. You will be the trusted technical advisor to Security, IT, and customer operations teams, and the connective tissue between those teams and Cyberhaven's Product, Engineering, and Customer Success organizations.

You will develop deep expertise in Cyberhaven's reimagined Agentic Data Security platform, including its inner workings, data lineage model, endpoint agents, and integrations. You will learn how our customers use it to mitigate data loss threats across their organizations. You are passionate about technology, naturally curious, and driven to exceed customer expectations. You take proactive ownership, anticipating issues before they surface, guiding customers toward best practices, and driving adoption and long-term value. When a problem needs engineering support, you own the escalation, bring a clear reproduction and technical context, and coordinate internally to full resolution.

Technical depth, a strong client focus, and experience with SaaS-based security products and endpoint agents (Windows, macOS, and Linux) are required. You will report to the Manager of Technical Account Managers.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Own the technical relationship**

  + Act as the technical owner of assigned accounts, with end-to-end knowledge of each customer's architecture, deployment, configuration, policies, and integrations.
  + Partner with customers and our Customer Experience teams through onboarding and rollout, including agent deployment strategy, policy design, and phased adoption plans.
  + Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across your book of business. Manage expectations and ensure stakeholder satisfaction.
  + Run regular check-ins and business reviews that cover technical health, adoption, risk, and goals. Raise emerging concerns before they escalate.

  ### **Be proactive**

  + Monitor account health, agent coverage, and usage patterns. Identify gaps, misconfigurations, and underused capabilities, and recommend optimizations.
  + Create and drive technical success plans that align customer objectives with Cyberhaven capabilities and deliverables.
  + Guide customers through upgrades, new feature rollouts, and environment changes (OS releases, MDM/GPO changes, network or infrastructure changes) to avoid disruption.
  + Advise customers on integrations with adjacent technologies such as SIEM, SOAR, and UEBA to extend the value of their deployment.
  + Stay current on industry trends and security best practices, and bring them to customers.

  ### **Resolve and escalate**

  + Analyze, troubleshoot, escalate and resolve complex technical issues across endpoint agents, cloud and SaaS integrations, and platform configuration.
  + Reproduce customer issues and document clear steps to replicate for Engineering and Development.
  + Serve as the internal and external point of contact on critical escalations. Drive prioritization with support engineering and keep customers informed through resolution.
  + Perform root cause analysis and drive preventive follow-ups so issues do not repeat.

  ### **Be the voice of the customer**

  + Coordinate customer feedback and feature requests to Product Management, Development, and Operations, with the technical and business context behind them.
  + Work cross-functionally as the expert on the Customer.
  + Collaborate with Customer Success and Sales on renewals, expansions, and risk mitigation, providing technical input and account insight.
  + Develop and maintain knowledge base articles, playbooks, and best-practice resources.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 3+ years of hands-on EDR/DLP endpoint experience.
* Expertise with DLP, Insider Threat, and CASB solutions.
* 3+ years in a Technical Account Management, Solutions/Sales Engineering, Professional Services, Technical Support, or similar customer-facing technical role.
* Demonstrated ability to own customer technical outcomes from implementation through steady-state operation, and to understand a customer's architecture and environment end-to-end.
* Hands-on experience deploying, supporting, and troubleshooting SaaS-based security and/or endpoint agent technologies.
* Proven experience resolving escalated technical customer issues and working directly with engineering teams.
* Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities, set timelines, track progress, and maintain clear documentation (success plans, project plans, status reports).
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills (English), including the ability to engage both hands-on practitioners and executive stakeholders.
* Practical knowledge of networking, security products, and enterprise network infrastructure.
* Deep knowledge of Windows, macOS, and Linux, including SCCM, GPO, Intune, registry configuration, PowerShell scripting, MDM, application management, and basic terminal skills.
* Software debugging skills: reading and searching logs (Windows, macOS, Linux, and Google Kubernetes Engine), running diagnostic scripts, and process management.
* Knowledge of system software design (services, drivers, agents).
* Based in EST timezone to support our customers.

### **Desired**

* Familiarity with adjacent technologies that Cyberhaven integrates with (SIEM, SOAR, UEBA).
* Prior experience as a TAM or in a similar proactive, account-owning role at a security or SaaS company.
* Background in L2/L3 or Escalation Engineering for EDR or DLP tools. This is a plus, not a primary requirement.

The position is entry-level, but we are looking for someone to take real ownership of it. Shipping and operations in New York will be this person's department to run, and there is room to grow as this side of the business expands.

At least one year's experience in shipping, logistics or operations is preferred. Short of that, we will consider candidates who can demonstrate a real interest in the work and a willingness to learn it properly.

**Shipping & Receiving:**

* Package and prepare books, prints, artworks, and other items for both international and domestic shipping.

jobs.description:
Logistics Coordinator

The Global Logistics Coordinator will be responsible for supporting the global transportation for Tarte Inc. The position is responsible for planning and coordinating the timely, cost-effective, and safe transport of all shipments while complying with government laws and regulations, including but not limited to: Customs and Border Protections (CBP), Export Administration Regulations (EAR), United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA), U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), Hazardous Goods, and the Code of Federal Regulations (CFR 19). The successful candidate will provide guidance and information to all personnel on inquiries regarding worldwide shipping options, Duty & VAT rates, and transit times.

Responsibilities:

* Accountable for determining the most safe, efficient, and cost-effective methods of coordinating freight shipments via ocean/truck/air/courier.
* Issue RFQs to multiple Forwarders and Carriers, organize and review all proposed rates and provide recommendations to the Logistics Team Lead.
* Review / compare freight invoices against quotes and submit to the Logistics Team Lead for review and final approval.
* Generate, maintain, and distribute all logistics documentation (inclusive of carrier shipping labels FedEx, UPS, DHL), including shipping documents, commercial invoice, customs forms, Shippers Letters of Instructions (SLI) and packing list.
* Track and follow up on all inbound/outbound domestic and international shipments to ensure timely deliveries to destination.
* Systematically post shipment receipts, update shipment details in our ERP, and perform daily reconciliations on posted vs. In-transit shipment reports
* Generate, maintain, and administer weekly Inbound shipment reports.
* Interface with international and domestic retail partners, foreign subsidiaries, distributors, 3PL, suppliers, brokers, and carriers to ensure compliance with all applicable import and export regulations.
* Communicate and trouble shoot all shipment related issues with suppliers, carriers, and internal teams.
* Work closely and build a relationship with the designated Customs brokers and carriers to coordinate timely and compliant flows of shipments.
* Comply with the packing and handling guidelines for all shipments in conjunction with product safety and security requirements.
* Assist cross-functional teams with logistics and customs related inquiries.
* Participate in continuous process improvements related to inbound / outbound shipments and manage recordkeeping of internal documentation and procedures. Conduct periodic process reviews, identify gaps, and implement necessary corrective actions.

Requirements:

* 1-3 years related work experience.
* Bachelor's degree in logistics, operations management, and/or business administration
* Working knowledge and understanding of global logistics, imports/exports, international & domestic freight shipments, US Customs, FDA, Hazardous goods, Duty & VAT, Incoterms, & HTS Classification

We value and celebrate diverse perspectives and strive to create a workplace where every individual can thrive. At the core of Cooley’s success is the exceptional talent and unwavering spirit of our people. We embrace individuality while fostering a ‘one-firm’ culture where collaboration and creativity thrive. Our people are the foundation of our success and the driving force behind everything we do.

**Hybrid Schedule Philosophy**: As part of the Cooley culture, we recognize and appreciate the value of being together, in person, to build comradery with others in the office and to be a contributing member of the Cooley office. However, we also appreciate the benefits and flexibility that come from remote working. As such, the default assumption for employees and partners is a hybrid schedule: some in-office presence and some work from home days absent certain essential in-office roles that require five (5) days/week in-office.

**Position summary:** Working closely with members of the external communications team, the Communications Assistant will provide day-to-day support for Cooley’s media relations, external communications and reputation-building efforts. The Communications Assistant will help the team identify and promote news involving Cooley, its clients and lawyers; support relationships with influential media; maintain the tools and resources that underpin an effective communications function; and assist with a range of written content and communications initiatives. Specific duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

**Position responsibilities:**

**Skills and experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, English, Marketing or a related field

* Familiarity with media monitoring, media databases or other public relations tools

**Competencies:**

* Excellent attention to detail
* Ability to organize, prioritize and coordinate multiple activities
* Strong judgment
* Team-player with collaborative spirit while also taking ownership of individual assignments
* Unwavering ability to maintain confidentiality regarding firm information, projects, client data
* High level of professionalism
* Self-starter who is able to work in a demanding, project-based environment
* Ability to multi-task, problem solve, work well under pressure and coordinate sophisticated marketing programs with good results
* Ability to consistently meet deadlines
* Passion and curiosity for current events and media, including, business, tech and legal sectors and media verticals
* Assertive, but flexible as to style; must be able to handle tense situations and interact with various personalities and communication styles at all levels in the organization
* Strong analytic and research and information-gathering skills
* High energy and genuine enthusiasm for law firm marketing and communications activities and goals while maintaining a healthy, competitive spirit
* Excellent communication skills both written and verbal
* Ability to take comprehensive and accurate notes
* Reliable and punctual
* Ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines
* Ability to learn new systems and processes quickly

Cooley offers a competitive compensation and excellent benefits package and is committed to fair and equitable employment practices. EOE.

jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Executive Assistant

**Location:** New York, NY

**Start Date**: ASAP

  

Whalar, part of Accenture Song is the leading, most awarded Creator and Social agency. We transform brands into cultural drivers by unlocking the full creative power of Creators.  
  
We go beyond the conventional social and influencer strategy. We have the technology and methodology to tap into the beating pulse of communities, listen to nuances that move culture, and connect brands in ways that make them unforgettable.  
  
With hubs in London, Berlin, New York, and Los Angeles, our reach is global.

Learn more: https://www.whalar.com/

**About the role:**
-------------------

Whalar Agency is looking for an Executive Assistant, New Business to be the right hand of our CEO and keep our New York office running smoothly. Reporting to our Chief of Staff, you'll own our CEO's calendar, travel and day-to-day priorities, staying a step ahead so things are handled before anyone has to ask. You'll also run our Wall Street office, making it a welcoming place for our team, clients and guests, and give hands-on support to our Chief of Staff, our client business team and other stakeholders across the business.

**Here's what you'll do day-to-day:**
-------------------------------------

* Own our CEO's complex, high-volume calendar, balancing competing priorities and sharing a weekly look-ahead so nothing catches them off guard.
* Plan travel for our CEO as soon as commitments are confirmed, laying out options and managing itineraries and logistics, including some personal and family travel arrangements and errands.
* Manage every client and guest visit from start to finish: registering guests with the building, welcoming them in the lobby and making sure meeting rooms are set up and ready.
* Run daily reception, making a great first impression on clients, guests and partners.
* Act as office manager for our Wall Street office: keep it well stocked and welcoming, coordinate vendors and catering, and organize team breakfasts, lunches and happy hours.
* Support our Chief of Staff, client business team and other senior stakeholders as needed, from office and team logistics to client setup, room bookings and expense reports. Occasionally support travel needs.
* Secure high-priority restaurant reservations and coordinate client dinners and event hospitality.
* Research upcoming meeting participants and key stakeholders on LinkedIn, and build structured attendee lookbooks ahead of external meetings and events.
* On occasion help prepare for Creator panels hosted by our leaders, including drafting questions that play to each Creator's strengths.

**Here's what we're looking for:**
----------------------------------

* Significant experience supporting a C-suite executive, including managing a complex calendar and travel.
* A proactive, anticipatory approach: you spot what's needed and handle it before you're asked, and you only need to be shown something once.
* Calm, sound judgment under pressure, with experience in fast-paced, high-stakes environments such as consulting, finance, tech or agencies.
* Experience running an office or front of house, with a hospitality-oriented mindset and confidence as the first point of contact for clients, guests and senior stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to juggle shifting priorities across several people without losing track of details.
* High discretion and sound judgment when handling confidential business information and personal or family details.
* Confidence with digital research, especially LinkedIn, and with turning what you find into clear, well-organized materials.
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication.

This role is based in our Wall Street, NY office, where you'll work on-site four days a week, Monday through Thursday. Being in the room with our leadership team is at the heart of this role, and you'll have the flexibility to work from home when our leaders are traveling or calendar demands allow.

The salary range for this role is $110,000 - $130,000 and serves as a general guideline for the potential compensation. The final salary offer will be determined based on a comprehensive evaluation of factors such as the candidate's experience, expertise, alignment with the position's requirements, location, and, ultimately, budget approvals.

**Our values:**
---------------

At Whalar, diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) isn't just a statement, it's our collective strength. Our people are our superpower. A diverse team and inclusive leadership have shaped Whalar since our inception in 2016, fueling a constant evolution of growth. We champion a culture of respect and empathy, fostering a sense of belonging that transcends demographics. We hire individuals of all backgrounds and empower them to thrive, challenge stereotypes, and actively break societal barriers.

jobs.title: Product Development Assistant (Intimates - Shapewear)
jobs.description:
Dreamwear is a leading wholesale intimate apparel and sleepwear company partnering with iconic brands including Juicy Couture, Laura Ashley, Danskin, Nautica, and many more. Through strong global partnerships and deep product expertise, we bring branded apparel from concept to market with a focus on great design, quality, value, and execution. Our products are sold through many of the world’s leading retailers, making Dreamwear a trusted partner across a diverse and growing portfolio of brands. Learn more at https://www.dreamwear.com/our-brands

We are seeking a Product Development Assistant to join our Shapewear team, supporting the development of shapewear across multiple brands within the Dreamwear portfolio. This is a hands-on opportunity to learn the full product development lifecycle in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.

Our Product Development team serves as the critical link between Design and our global factory partners, helping transform creative concepts into commercially viable, production-ready product. For shapewear, this requires particularly close attention to fabrication, fit, construction, functionality, quality, and performance, while balancing cost and delivery requirements. The team coordinates sample development, communicates product specifications and approvals, and tracks each style from initial development through production.

The Product Development Assistant will support the team throughout this process, coordinating with overseas factories and internal partners to keep samples, approvals, purchase orders, and production milestones moving forward. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who is eager to develop strong technical and product knowledge within the intimates and shapewear categories.

### **Duties & Responsibilities**

* Communicate daily with overseas manufacturers and production offices regarding product development, sampling, approvals, and production status.
* Assist with the development and execution of shapewear styles from initial concept through production.
* Prepare purchase orders for overseas factories and track production and delivery status to support on-time execution.
* Maintain time-and-action calendars and production tracking charts, proactively following up on upcoming deadlines and outstanding items.
* Initiate and track development samples, material requests, lab dips, testing, approvals, and other product development submissions.
* Follow up on product specifications, quality standards, sample deadlines, testing requirements, and deliveries.
* Partner with Design and PD teams to help ensure fabrics, trims, construction details, fit requirements, and other product specifications are accurately communicated to factory partners.
* Enter and maintain accurate product information within our production management system, including style setup and purchase order creation and maintenance.
* Coordinate and track pre-production, photo, customer, and TOP samples.
* Receive, organize, and distribute incoming samples and packages from overseas vendors.
* Maintain organized product development samples and reference materials throughout the office.
* Identify outstanding items and potential timing issues and escalate them to the appropriate PD team member.
* Assist Product Development Managers with additional projects and seasonal priorities as needed.
* ***This job description is not intended to be exhaustive. Duties and responsibilities may be changed or modified at any time at the discretion of management.***

### **Job Requirements & Qualifications**

* 0–2 years of relevant work experience; prior internship or work experience in apparel, intimates, shapewear, product development, production, or sourcing is a plus.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple styles, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent organizational and follow-through skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable following up with both internal teams and external partners.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and within a collaborative team environment.
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to ask questions, learn, and take ownership.
* Interest in apparel construction, fit, fabrics, and the product development process; interest in intimates or shapewear is a plus.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Strong desire to learn, develop, and grow within the company.

**Compensation & Benefits**

The base salary range for this position is $52-58k yearly.

The base salary range represents the low and high end of the anticipated salary range for this position. The actual salary offered will depend on numerous factors including, without limitation, experience and business objectives. Our base salary is just one component of our total rewards package that also includes other health and wealth benefits including medical, dental and vision insurance; pre-tax commuter/parking and other flexible spending accounts; paid time off plus many additional holidays; 401(k); gym discount; and more.

**Marketing & Administrative Coordinator**

**Brookhaven Family Dentistry**  
**Chamblee, Georgia**  
**Full Time, 40 Hours Per Week**  
**$25 to $35 Per Hour, Based on Experience and Skill Level**

Brookhaven Family Dentistry is looking for a highly motivated, tech savvy, organized, and outgoing individual to join our team as a **Marketing & Administrative Coordinator**.

This is a unique position that combines approximately **50% marketing and community relations with 50% administrative and project support**.

We are not looking for someone who simply waits to be given a list of tasks. We are looking for someone who can be given a goal or project, research it, figure out the best way to accomplish it, and take ownership of getting it completed.

The right person will be resourceful, dependable, comfortable learning new technology, able to manage multiple projects at the same time, and confident representing our practice in the community.

This is an ideal position for someone who enjoys variety. You may spend one morning creating TikTok videos, the afternoon creating an Excel tracker, another day coordinating one of our school partnerships, and later in the week representing our practice at a Chamber of Commerce event.

**Marketing and Digital Responsibilities**

Responsibilities will include:

* Help develop and manage our presence on TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Reddit, and other digital platforms
* Plan, film, edit, organize, and publish short form video content
* Maintain a basic understanding of SEO and GEO concepts and how social media platforms, Reddit, YouTube, and our website can contribute to search visibility

You will not be expected to regularly appear on camera. Your primary responsibilities will be researching, planning, filming, editing, organizing, and managing content.

**Community Relations**

Brookhaven Family Dentistry is heavily involved in our local community.

This position will help manage and grow those relationships.

Responsibilities will include:

* Coordinate our partnerships and sponsorships with local schools and businesses
* Attend approximately 5-10 weekend school or community events per year where Brookhaven Family Dentistry may have a booth, table, sponsorship, or other presence
* Attend occasional evening marketing or community events
* Represent Brookhaven Family Dentistry at Chamber of Commerce meetings and other local business events
* Confidently introduce yourself to other business owners and community leaders and promote the practice
* Develop relationships with schools, businesses, community organizations, police departments, fire departments, and other local organizations

**Administrative and Project Support**

Approximately half of this position will involve helping our office managers and leadership team with administrative projects.

Responsibilities may include:

* Creating and maintaining Excel spreadsheets
* Organizing and tracking projects
* Creating reports and organizing information
* Helping managers complete projects and follow up on outstanding items
* Communicating with vendors, organizations, and business partners

All responsibilities associated with this position are business related. This is not a personal assistant position.

**Technology Skills**

The ideal candidate should be comfortable with technology and willing to quickly learn unfamiliar programs.

Strong familiarity with several of the following is preferred:

* Microsoft Excel
* Microsoft Office
* TikTok
* Instagram
* Facebook
* YouTube
* Reddit
* Video editing software
* ChatGPT
* Claude

Candidates should be comfortable performing common Excel functions, including creating basic formulas and using features such as Text to Columns.

You do not need to be an expert in every platform listed above. However, you must be someone who is comfortable researching unfamiliar technology and teaching yourself how to use it.

**What We Are Looking For**

More than anything, we are looking for someone who is capable, resourceful, and dependable.

The ideal candidate:

* Can consistently arrive and be ready to work by **7:45 AM**
* Has strong organizational and time management skills
* Speaks up and asks questions when something is unclear
* Is comfortable approaching and speaking with people they do not know
* Is comfortable receiving work related texts or calls outside normal business hours

**Schedule and Availability**

This is a full time, 40 hour per week position based primarily at our Chamblee office.

**Education and Experience**

A bachelor's degree is preferred but is not an absolute requirement.

Exceptional experience, technical ability, organizational skills, and demonstrated competency may substitute for a college degree.

Previous experience in marketing, social media, administration, project coordination, community relations, or a similar position is helpful.

**Compensation**

jobs.title: National Account Manager, eCommerce
jobs.description:
Eaton’s North America Sales - Distributed Infrastructure Technology (DIT) division is currently seeking a National Account Manager, eCommerce within 50 miles of Woodridge, IL, Moon Township, PA, North Little Rock, AR Raleigh, NC, Beachwood, OH, Dallas/Fort Worth, TX, Smyrna, GA, Nashville, TN, Charlotte, NC, or Tukwila, WA.

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

**Job summary**

The National Account Manager, Ecommerce is responsible for developing and executing omnichannel sales and growth strategies across Eaton's key ecommerce and retail customers. This role leads strategic customer relationships with Amazon and approximately six additional ecommerce retailers while supporting brick-and-mortar retail partnerships to deliver a seamless customer experience across online and offline channels.
  
  
The position serves as the primary commercial leader for assigned national accounts, driving revenue growth, market share expansion, category growth, customer engagement, and profitable sales performance. The role collaborates cross-functionally with product management, marketing, category management, supply chain, customer service, and sales leadership to develop and execute customer strategies aligned with Eaton's omnichannel growth objectives.
  
  
The successful candidate will possess expertise in ecommerce, omnichannel sales, key account management, online marketplace management, digital merchandising, retail media, strategic business planning, and customer development. This position requires up to 25% travel to customer locations, industry events, trade shows, and internal meetings.
  
  
**Job responsibilities**

* Develop and execute strategic omnichannel business plans for Amazon and approximately six assigned ecommerce and retail accounts to achieve sales, profit, revenue growth, and market share objectives.

* Own customer relationships at multiple organizational levels within assigned accounts and serve as Eaton's primary commercial point of contact.

* Identify and develop growth opportunities through assortment expansion, promotional programs, ecommerce initiatives, retail media, digital merchandising, marketplace optimization, and new product introductions.

* Lead annual business planning, forecasting, joint business planning, and customer business review processes with assigned customers.

* Analyze customer performance, category trends, market conditions, competitive activity, and business data to identify opportunities, risks, and growth strategies.

* Develop pricing, promotional, assortment, and omnichannel sales strategies that support profitable growth and customer objectives across ecommerce and brick-and-mortar channels.

* Partner with marketing, ecommerce, product management, retail sales, supply chain, customer service, and operations teams to improve customer engagement and execution.

* Drive execution of digital content, merchandising, advertising, retail media, and ecommerce initiatives that improve online visibility, conversion, and sales performance.

* Communicate voice-of-customer insights to internal stakeholders and influence product, marketing, sales, and ecommerce strategies.

* Build and maintain a multi-year opportunity pipeline to support long-term growth objectives and customer development plans.

* Negotiate annual agreements, promotional programs, pricing initiatives, and business plans that align customer needs with Eaton's strategic objectives.

* Collaborate across multiple business units, sales teams, and channel partners to maximize share of wallet, customer penetration, and omnichannel growth.

* Support the development and utilization of dashboards, reporting tools, business intelligence, and analytics used to drive customer growth and business decisions.

* Build executive-level customer relationships and influence strategic business decisions that support mutual growth and long-term partnerships.

* Drive best practices in ecommerce, omnichannel selling, category management, marketplace management, and customer development.

* Travel up to 25% to support customer meetings, business reviews, industry events, trade shows, and internal strategic planning activities.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution required.

* Minimum 5 years of experience in sales, ecommerce, omnichannel sales, marketing, or national account management.

* Ability and willingness to travel up to 25% as required.

* Experience managing strategic national accounts across ecommerce, marketplace, and brick-and-mortar retail channels, including Amazon and other national ecommerce retailers.

* Demonstrated success developing and executing customer business plans, forecasting processes, joint business plans, and revenue growth strategies.

* Experience influencing cross-functional stakeholders and driving results within a matrix organization.

jobs.title: Territory Account Manager – Industrial / Loading Dock Equipment
jobs.description:
Outside Sales Representative – Loading Dock Equipment

**Extreme Dock Equipment** is a growing manufacturer of loading dock equipment based in Southern California. We manufacture **dock seals, dock shelters, and related loading dock products** and sell through distributors throughout the United States.

We are looking for an experienced **Outside Sales Representative** to build and grow our **East Coast and Midwest territory — everything east of Denver, CO.**

**Home-based position | Atlanta, Charlotte, or Columbus preferred | Extensive travel**

**The more you build, the more you earn.**

A performance bonus is also available for achieving defined territory-development and customer-acquisition goals.

The Opportunity

This is a **territory-building position**, not an account-maintenance role.

You will be responsible for developing Extreme Dock Equipment's distributor network throughout the territory and creating new business.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

* Prospecting and developing new distributor accounts
* Building relationships with loading dock and material handling distributors
* Growing sales through distributor sales teams
* Identifying new market opportunities
* Calling on distributor owners, purchasing managers, sales managers, and outside salespeople
* Training distributor sales teams on Extreme Dock Equipment products
* Developing opportunities and following up on quotes
* Managing your sales pipeline
* Traveling throughout the territory to meet distributors and customers
* Attending industry trade shows and customer meetings
* Monitoring competitors and providing market feedback
* Building long-term relationships that produce repeat business

You will have significant responsibility for **building and growing the territory**.

Who We're Looking For

We are looking for an experienced B2B outside salesperson with a background in **loading dock equipment, material handling, warehouse equipment, industrial products, construction products, or a closely related industry.**

Strongly preferred experience:

* Loading dock equipment
* Dock seals and dock shelters
* Dock levelers
* Vehicle restraints
* Industrial doors
* Material handling equipment
* Warehouse equipment
* Industrial or commercial construction products
* Distributor/dealer sales

**Experience selling through distributors is strongly preferred.**

The ideal candidate understands how the loading dock and material handling industry works and has existing relationships with distributors or end users in the territory.

What We're Looking For

* 2+ years of successful outside sales experience
* Proven ability to develop new business
* B2B sales experience
* Strong prospecting skills
* Strong relationship-building skills
* Excellent communication and follow-up
* Comfortable selling to business owners and decision-makers
* Comfortable training distributor sales teams
* Self-motivated and able to work independently
* Organized and disciplined
* Competitive and motivated by results
* Willingness to travel extensively
* Valid driver's license

Territory

**All markets east of Denver, Colorado.**

The territory includes the:

* Midwest
* Great Lakes
* Southeast
* Mid-Atlantic
* Northeast
* Southern states

This is a **home-based position with significant travel throughout the territory.**

**Preferred locations:** Atlanta, GA; Charlotte, NC; or Columbus, OH.

Exceptional candidates located elsewhere within the territory will also be considered.

Why Extreme Dock Equipment?

Extreme Dock Equipment is a growing manufacturer with an opportunity to significantly expand its distributor network across the United States.

This position will work directly with company leadership and will have a meaningful role in determining how the territory develops.

You won't be inheriting a mature territory and simply maintaining existing accounts.

**You'll be building it.**

We are looking for someone who wants to develop a substantial book of business and be rewarded for the results they produce.

If you're an experienced industrial salesperson who enjoys prospecting, building relationships, and winning new business, this is an opportunity to have a direct impact on the growth of a manufacturing company.

Apply

If you have experience selling **loading dock equipment, material handling equipment, industrial products, warehouse equipment, construction products, or related B2B products**, we'd like to hear from you.

Please submit a resume highlighting:

* Outside sales experience
* Territory responsibility
* Industries and products sold
* Distributor/dealer experience
* Sales performance and accomplishments
* Geographic territory experience

Pay: $100,000.00 - $200,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

**Customer Success Manager, Manufacturing**

At Poka, we're changing how the world's industrial teams work, capturing the knowledge of their best people and putting it in every operator's hands.

Our connected worker platform is purpose-built for manufacturing and the wider industrial world, with industrial AI inside the shift, not on top of it. The result: frontline performance that becomes compounding knowledge and measurable impact, every shift, every site, every region.

We're proud to support global leaders like Nestlé, Bosch, Mars, and Danone across 3,000+ sites in 70+ countries. And as a fast-growing part of the IFS family, you'll join a team whose daily work directly shapes the platform behind how modern manufacturing gets done.

You've spent time on the floor. You know what an unplanned stop or a rushed changeover really costs. Now you get to help the plants using Poka fix those problems at scale.

**Role overview**

As a Customer Success Manager, you'll look after a portfolio of manufacturing customers and help them get real, measurable value from Poka. You'll guide sites from early adoption through to renewal, help their teams apply Poka to their CI and TPM work, and become the person they call when they want to do more.

You'll report to our Director of Customer Success and work alongside experienced Senior CSMs who'll help you ramp up. Your manufacturing background is the foundation. We'll teach you the SaaS side.

* Work closely with Onboarding, Support, Product and Sales so customers get a joined-up experience

* Experience training people, leading improvement events or supporting a new system rollout on site
* Comfort with operational data like OEE, downtime and scrap, and the ability to explain what the numbers mean
* Solid organisation skills and the ability to keep several accounts moving at once
* Curiosity about technology and AI. You've already tried AI tools at work and want to get better with them
* Clear written and verbal communication in English (French is a bonus)

* 100% remote work if you do not live within the radiuses mentioned above.

jobs.title: Manager, Sales Operations
jobs.description:
Aderant is a global industry leading software company providing comprehensive business management solutions for law firms and other professional services organizations with a mission to help them run a better business. We are motivated by a collective desire to drive the legal industry to the forefront of innovation. With over 2,500 clients around the world, including 95 of the top AmLaw 100 firms, we are changing the outside perception of the legal sphere; where there was once resistance to modernization, we are creating a culture that embraces new ideas and technology.

At Aderant, the “A” is more than just a letter. It is a representation of how we fulfill our foundational purpose, serving our clients. It embodies our core values and reminds us that to achieve success, every day must start with the “A”. We bring the “A” to life by fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and personal growth. We encourage our diverse teams to bring their whole selves to work – ideas, experience, and passion – to drive our mission forward.

Our people are our strength.

**About the Role**

We're hiring a Sales Operation Manager to lead the team responsible for quote creation, pricing calculators, and proposal generation across our sales organization. This role owns the day-to-day execution of our quoting function while also driving improvements to our CPQ platform, ensuring compliance across product lines, and acting as the connective tissue between Sales, Marketing, Product, Finance, and Business Systems on go-to-market process standards.

You'll manage a small, high-throughput team supporting a fast-moving sales org — balancing hands-on people leadership with strategic ownership of the tools and processes that make deals move faster and more accurately.

**What You'll Do**

**Team Leadership**

* Manage and develop a team of analysts setting priorities, reviewing workload, and ensuring consistent SLAs on quote and proposal turnaround

* Coach the team on complex or non-standard quoting scenarios; serve as the escalation point when reps need faster or more senior support

* Own hiring, onboarding, and performance management for the team

**Quoting, Calculators & Proposals**

* Oversee the creation and accuracy of sales quotes, pricing/migration calculators, and customer-facing proposals
* Set quality standards and review processes for calculator logic and proposal content to reduce errors and rework
* Identify recurring quote/proposal issues and drive fixes upstream (templates, pricing logic, CPQ configuration)
* **CPQ Ownership & Improvement**
* Act as the business-side owner of CPQ testing, diagnosing configuration issues, and advising on fixes with IT/Systems teams
* Prioritize and track CPQ enhancement requests based on impact to deal velocity and rep experience
* Partner with IT on UAT for CPQ releases, patches, and new pricing model rollouts

**Ad Hoc & Rep Support**

* Ensure the team is responsive to ad hoc requests from sales reps without sacrificing quality or SLAs
* Build self-serve resources (FAQs, templates, guides) to reduce repetitive ad hoc volume over time

**Cross-Functional Process**

* Partner with Sales, Marketing, Product, Finance, and Business Systems to standardize GTM processes tied to quoting, pricing, and proposals
* Represent the quoting function in cross-functional planning (new product launches, pricing changes, packaging updates)
* Bring data and trends from the quoting queue to inform broader GTM decisions

**What We're Looking For**

* 4+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Quoting, or Quote-to-Cash roles, ideally in B2B SaaS

* 1+ years of people management experience, or demonstrated readiness to step into a first management role

* Hands-on experience with CPQ platforms (Salesforce CPQ, or similar) — configuration, testing, and troubleshooting

* Strong Excel skills; comfort building or maintaining pricing calculators

* Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Business Systems, Finance, and Product/Marketing teams

* Excellent attention to detail — this team is the last line of accuracy before deals reach customers

* Clear, calm communicator who can manage competing priorities and rep escalations under time pressure

**What Success Looks Like in the First 6 Months**

* Team SLAs for quote/proposal turnaround are consistently met or improved

* A prioritized CPQ improvement roadmap is in place, with quick wins already shipped

* Cross-functional partners (Sales, Business Systems, Product, Finance) view the team as a proactive partner, not just a quoting queue

jobs.description:
**Hi, We're AppFolio**
----------------------

We're innovators, changemakers, and collaborators. We're more than a software company. We're pioneers in cloud and AI who deliver magical experiences that make our customers' lives easier. We're revolutionizing how people do business in the real estate industry, and we want your ideas, enthusiasm, and passion to help us keep innovating.

You'll be the trusted advisor to sophisticated operators. You'll build relationships at every level, from owners and VPs to day-to-day teams. You'll use your industry knowledge to help customers get measurable results from the AppFolio Real Estate Performance Management (RPM) platform.

* Develop business cases and secure leadership alignment for new growth initiatives, partnerships, and investment opportunities
* Build strong relationships with aggregator partner leadership and influence roadmaps that support Papa Johns growth objectives

* Build strong and high-quality storytelling through decks, business reviews, and executive presentations for key internal stakeholders and external partners

* Restaurant, QSR, retail, consumer packaged goods, or digital commerce experience preferred
* Experience developing business cases, growth strategies, and managing marketing investments or budgets

**Functional Skills**

* Commercial and marketplace partnership acumen
* Financial and business acumen
* Growth: analyze, assess, align, execute, and drive measurable results
* Deep understanding of digital commerce, aggregators, customer acquisition, retention, and frequency drivers

* Ability to effectively communicate, inform, and influence senior leaders and external partners
* Ability to work cross-functionally and collaboratively on multiple initiatives with a successful record of advancing projects

jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

Are you ready to transform lives through academic excellence, innovative research, strong community partnerships and economic opportunity? Kennesaw State University is one of the 50 largest public institutions in the country. With growing enrollment and global reach, we continue to expand our institutional influence and prominence beyond the state of Georgia. We offer more than 190 undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral degrees to empower over 50,000 students to become thought leaders, lifelong learners, and informed global citizens. Our entrepreneurial spirit, high-impact research, and Division I athletics draw students from throughout the region and from more than 100 countries across the globe. Our university's vibrant culture, career opportunities, rich benefits, and values of respect, integrity, collaboration, inclusivity, and accountability make us an employer of choice. We are part of the University System of Georgia. We are searching for talented people to join Kennesaw State University in our vision. Come Take Flight at KSU!

**Location**
------------

**(Primary Location for Job Responsibilities)** Our Kennesaw campus is located at 1000 Chastain Road NW, Kennesaw, GA 30144.

Our Marietta campus is located at 1100 South Marietta Parkway, Marietta, GA 30060.

**Job Summary**
---------------

Provides support for departmental fiscal services and responsibilities, procurement, research purchasing, laboratory stockroom management, and coordination of selected laboratory operations. Coordinates faculty startup and other research and/or departmental purchases across the division. Navigates University financial, procurement, and ordering systems, resolves purchasing issues across systems, supports the fiscal and procurement administration of equipment service and maintenance contracts. Oversees stockroom operations, chemical inventory, supplies, and assigned student employees. Assists with shared scientific equipment, equipment maintenance and repair coordination, surplus equipment processes, and coordination of chemical-waste disposal with the appropriate University offices.

**Responsibilities**
