1. Coordinates faculty startup, research, and departmental purchasing  
2. Processes and track orders, navigates ePro and university fiscal and procurement systems, troubleshoot transactions, and maintains purchasing documentation  
3. Coordinates the fiscal and procurement aspects of equipment service, maintenance, and other laboratory-related contracts, including purchase orders, renewals, invoices, funding sources, and contract tracking  
4. Manages the department's laboratory stockroom operations, including chemical inventory, supplies, stock levels, ordering, receipt, organization, distribution, and routing of scientific supplies and equipment  
5. Anticipates instructional and research supply needs  
6. As needed, assists division units with shared scientific equipment and related operational needs,  
7. Coordinates equipment maintenance and repair requests  
8. Facilitates surplus-property processes, and coordinates chemical-waste disposal with Environmental Health and Safety or other appropriate departments  
9. Recruits, hires, trains, schedules, and supervises assigned student employees supporting stockroom operations, assigns work, monitors performance, and maintains appropriate stockroom coverage

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

**Educational Requirements**  
Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution of higher education or an equivalent combination of relevant education and/or experience.  
  
**Required Experience**  
Two (2) years of related experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

**Preferred Educational Qualifications**  
An advanced degree from an accredited institution of higher education in a related field  
  
**Preferred Experience**  
An advanced degree from an accredited institution of higher education in a related field  
Experience with procurement and fiscal operations in a university or research environment
  
Experience with ePro or similar system; P-card purchasing and reconciliation, scientific purchasing, laboratory stockroom or inventory management  
Student employee supervisory experience

**Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities**
----------------------------------

**ABILITIES**  
Able to navigate multiple financial and procurement systems and troubleshoot transactions across systems  
Able to manage multiple purchases, including complex research and scientific-equipment orders  
Able to communicate effectively with faculty, staff, students, vendors, and central administrative offices  
Able to supervise and train student employees on department stockroom duties such as barcoding chemicals, weekly inspections of eyewashes station, lab supplies inventory, etc.  
Able to track and coordinate the fiscal and procurement aspects of service agreements, maintenance contracts, renewals, and related vendor activity  
Able to handle multiple tasks or projects at one time meeting assigned deadlines  
  
**KNOWLEDGE**  
Strong knowledge of purchasing, procurement, and fiscal processes  
Familiarity with laboratory equipment lifecycle processes, including maintenance and repair coordination, shared-equipment support, surplus-property procedures  
Familiarity with chemical inventory and chemical-waste disposal coordination  
Experience with ePro or comparable electronic procurement systems and knowledge of P-card procedures  
Understanding of laboratory operations and science-department purchasing and inventory needs  
  
**SKILLS**  
Excellent interpersonal, initiative, teamwork, problem solving, independent judgment, organization, communication (verbal and written), time management, project management and presentation skills  
Strong organizational, inventory, record-management, and follow-up skills  
Proficient with computer applications

jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Night Operations Coordinator

**Department:** House Operations  
**Reports To:** House Manager
  
**FLSA Status:** Non-Exempt

**Employment Status:** Full Time  
**Date Revised:** October 2026

**Job Purpose**

The Night Operations Coordinator supports safe, efficient House operations during evening and overnight hours and provides shift coverage and operational support for House, Evening, Night, and Weekend Managers as needed. This position fosters a warm, comfortable, and secure environment for Guest Families, volunteers, and visitors while ensuring continuity of House services.

**Work Hours**

This is a full-time, on-site position with standard hours of Monday through Friday, 10:30 p.m. to 7:00 a.m., when not covering an alternate shift. Flexibility for evenings, nights, and weekends is required.

**Essential Functions**

**Emergency & Facilities Response:**

* Perform routine House walkthroughs/facility inspections and update maintenance records in Family Registry as needed.
* Ensure the environment is kept neat and clean at all times.
* Adhere to health and insurance safety standards required for Ronald McDonald Houses.
* Supervise House cleaning or maintenance tasks as directed by the Facilities Manager.
* Conduct emergency repairs when necessary.
* Keep all storage areas organized and tidy.
* Monitor fire alarms, smoke detectors, and phone systems to ensure they are always operational.
* Address any emergency maintenance needs during scheduled work time and contact Facilities Manager immediately if needed.

**House Management:**

* Cover shifts for House Managers as needed, including evening, night, and weekend hours.
* Manage office operations and House activity during scheduled shifts.
* Oversee referrals, room assignments, and guest check-in/check-out procedures.
* Coordinate with hotel partners for overflow lodging when applicable.
* Maintain accurate guest data in Family Registry and other database systems.
* Respond to phone calls and in-person inquiries in a timely and professional manner.
* Carry the House emergency phone during all work hours and respond as needed.
* Assist with inventory tracking & communicate supply needs to the House Manager.
* Support weekly room checks and daily walkthroughs to assess cleanliness, safety, and guest comfort.
* Document maintenance and housekeeping needs and notify Facilities Manager.
* Ensure accurate in-kind donation records are completed for all items received during assigned shifts.
* Maintain professional communication with hospital referral staff.
* Follow all accounting procedures and Ronald McDonald House Atlanta documentation protocols.

**Guest, Donor, and Volunteer Relations:**

* Maintain a clean environment and create an atmosphere of hospitality, ensuring the well-being and comfort of families.
* Clarify and tactfully enforce Ronald McDonald House Guest Rules/Policies and Procedures.
* Articulate the mission and vision of the Charity, including its history; provide House tours as needed.
* Promote community awareness of Ronald McDonald House Atlanta.
* Perform other duties as assigned to support the House and its mission.

**Qualifications**

* College degree and work experience in Human Services.
* Excellent communication, organizational, time management, sound judgment, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to conduct oneself tactfully in dealing with Guest Families and volunteers.
* Experience working with infirm or disabled children and families.
* Exceptional customer service skills with the ability to interact effectively with a broad range of constituents including families, volunteers, staff, and community members.
* Ability to work and remain calm under pressure, meet multiple deadlines, and multitask effectively.
* Commitment to service, organizational values, and professionalism, demonstrated through conduct and demeanor at all times.
* Work in a positive and nurturing manner with volunteers, community groups, donors, and support staff in the House.
* Highly motivated self-starter with strategic thinking ability; able to work independently as well as collaboratively with a team-oriented personality.
* Possess compassion, tact, honesty, trustworthiness, good listening skills, flexibility, and professionalism.
* Demonstrate respect for the privacy and confidentiality of all Guests.
* Show genuine interest in the successful operation of both House programs.
* Ability to express ideas clearly, concisely, and logically, both orally and in writing.
* Visual acuity sufficient to operate a computer terminal and read extensively.
* Working knowledge of computers with competency in Microsoft 365 and database programs.
* Above all, capable of thinking clearly and reacting professionally while providing comfort to individuals during personal trauma, such as dealing with a child's chronic illness or death.
* Must be in good general health to ensure the well-being of the families.

**Key Competencies**

* Compassion and empathy
* Tact and discretion
* Initiative and flexibility
* Collaboration and teamwork
* Attention to detail
* Accountability and professionalism

**Working Conditions & Physical Demands**

* Must be able to lift and transport up to 50 pounds.
* Sit at a desk approximately 30–40% of the day.
* Frequent walking, standing, and stair climbing.
* Ability to climb stairs and access mechanical/utility areas.
* Visual and auditory acuity required for communication, safety, and documentation.

**Disclaimer**

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the position. Management reserves the right to revise or amend duties as needed due to business necessity or organizational changes.

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator II- Mission Critical Project Specialist
jobs.description:
The Logistics Coordinator II is responsible for the end-to-end execution of time critical freight movements across air, ocean, road, and multimodal solutions. This role requires a high degree of urgency, problem-solving, and coordination to ensure freight moves according to required timelines, customer expectations, and regulatory requirements

**Locations:** Houston, TX | Atlanta, GA | Los Angeles, CA | Elk Grove Village, IL

**Schedule Required:**  
Wednesday-Friday: 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM  
Saturday-Sunday: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

**Please Note:** This position requires evening and weekend coverage and the ability to work a flexible schedule based on business needs.

**About the Role**
------------------

Imperative Logistics is seeking a highly motivated **Logistics Coordinator II**

to support our growing expedited and high-priority freight operations. This role is ideal for an experienced logistics professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, communicates effectively under pressure, and takes ownership of shipments from start to finish.

We are looking for someone who can step into a critical operational role with a strong foundation in freight forwarding, transportation, or multimodal logistics. While training will be provided, candidates should have hands-on experience managing freight movements and solving transportation challenges in real time.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Manage time-sensitive shipments across air, ocean, truckload, LTL, expedited, and multimodal transportation networks.
* Monitor and track shipments throughout the transportation lifecycle, proactively identifying and resolving delays or service interruptions.
* Coordinate with carriers, customers, vendors, and global partners to ensure successful execution of critical freight movements.
* Arrange transportation capacity and evaluate routing options to meet customer delivery requirements.
* Provide timely communication and status updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Support mission-critical, high-priority, and expedited freight shipments requiring immediate attention and rapid response.
* Collaborate with Sales, Customer Service, Compliance, and Operations teams to ensure service excellence and SLA compliance.
* Utilize CargoWise One and other transportation management systems to manage shipments, documentation, and tracking activities.
* Assist with project cargo and specialized freight movements as needed.
* Participate in evening, weekend, and after-hours coverage to support customer requirements and operational demands.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

jobs.title: Program Coordinator Manager
jobs.description:
### **Who We Are**

At ERC Pathlight, we're on a mission to change lives—and we're looking for people who feel called to do the same.

As one of the nation's leading treatment providers for eating disorders and mood, anxiety, and trauma-related conditions, we bring innovative, evidence-based, and deeply compassionate care to patients across the country. With multiple locations nationwide and extensive virtual programming, we meet patients exactly where they are and help them move toward lasting recovery.

Founded in 2008 by renowned psychiatrists and psychologists, ERC Pathlight now supports more than 6,000 patients each year. And as the need for world-class mental health care continues to rise, our commitment is stronger than ever: to expand access, elevate the standard of care, and empower every patient to rebuild their life with dignity and hope.

### **Why Join Us**

When you join ERC Pathlight, you become part of a team that shows up every day to make a real difference. You'll work alongside passionate clinicians, dedicated support staff, and mission-driven leaders who believe in collaboration, growth, and doing the right thing—always.

Here, your work matters. Your ideas matter. **You** matter.

If you're energized by purpose, motivated by impact, and ready to help transform the future of mental health treatment, you belong here.

**Come build hope. Come save lives. Come grow with us.**

**What you'll be doing:**

Schedule:

3 days/week: 8:30 AM - 5:00PM  
2 days/week: 12:00 PM - 8:30 PM

Requirement: 1 weekend day or every other weekend

The Program Coordinator Manager (PC Manager) is responsible for overall program delivery and staffing at their assigned site. In partnership with site leadership, the PC Manager oversees Program Coordinators to ensure high-quality, consistent delivery of patient programming, including responsibility for scheduling and Paid Time Off (PTO) management.

**Essential duties and responsibilities:**

* Provides oversight of the assigned team by supervising, guiding, and directing employees to ensure effective performance

* Ensures team members are equipped with the appropriate skills, tools, and capabilities to execute their duties

* Utilizes established people processes (performance management, development, succession planning, and career progression) to meet current and future performance standards

* Conducts performance evaluations, provides coaching and counseling on performance issues, and promotes a positive and supportive work environment

* Oversees the hiring and onboarding process for new Program Coordinators and serves as a direct mentor for licensure supervision assignments.

* Develops and fully implements flexible staffing plans to efficiently align staffing levels with patient census

* Participates in group facilitation and provides direct patient care support as needed for supervision purposes and in response to facility needs

* Ensures all required documentation for Program Coordinators is completed accurately and in compliance with regulatory standards, and participates in ongoing chart audits

* Achieves clinical and operational objectives by contributing insights and recommendations to strategic planning. Implements patient-focused standards by resolving issues, completing audits, identifying trends, recommending system improvements, and supporting the implementation of change

* Interfaces with Housing and Transportation, Nursing, Treatment Teams, Facilities and contracted Food Services Management leadership and staff

* Serve as a Handle with Care (HWC) Trainer for the program, providing initial and refresher training, maintaining certification, and ensuring compliance with HWC standards and practices

**Must haves:**

* High school diploma or GED (required)

* 1 year experience in behavioral health setting (required)

* 6+ months experience of leading or supervising teams OR 1+ years' experience within ERC demonstrating leadership aptitude (required)

**Bonus qualities:**

* 2+ years' experience in behavioral health setting (preferred)

#ERC

**What We Offer**

At ERC Pathlight, caring for people is our mission and that begins with caring for our own team. Your well-being matters, and our benefit program is designed to support every part of your life.

We offer competitive compensation; comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage; generous Paid Time Off; Parental Leave benefits; Retirement benefits; and tuition reimbursement to help you continue growing in your career.

We also recognize that mental health is part of every person's experience. That's why we strive to create a workplace where you feel supported, seen, and encouraged—personally, professionally, and at home.

When you thrive, you can do your best work. And your best work changes lives.

jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

Join our team as an Enterprise Technical Account Manager at Talon.One, where you'll play a key role in driving the success of our API-first promotion engine for our enterprise clients across the growing Americas region. You'll take ownership of the technical integration process, ensuring our platform fits seamlessly into each client's ecosystem. As the technical lead for your portfolio, you'll proactively monitor API usage, resolve recurring issues, and manage escalations in close collaboration with our Engineering and Customer Success teams.

You'll lead onboarding design, manage expectations, and deliver consistent value that boosts retention, growth, and satisfaction. In this strategic role, you'll also explore new tech partnerships and integration opportunities that expand our ecosystem and unlock more value for our customers.

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM:**

Our global team of 15+ Technical Account Managers is spread across the world, including EMEA, US, and APAC. We always strive for a seamless client onboarding and bug-free integration, while balancing ever-changing client requests on a daily basis. Our team works closely with Customer Success Managers and the development team, enabling us to act as consultants to all parties involved in the client onboarding journey. Ultimately, handling expectations related to the integration of our platform is where we drive value for our clients & our company.

Our team is defined by our commitment to mutual support and our dedication to deep problem-solving. These qualities are essential in future teammates in order for us to continue building on our strengths.

The estimated total compensation for this role is $115,500, though actual compensation may vary depending on factors such as relevant experience, skills, qualifications, certifications, and location. The salary range is subject to change and may be adjusted at any time. For this role, you must be located within commuting distance of one of our US hubs: New York, Chicago, San Francisco, or Boston.

  

**ONCE YOU ARE HERE YOU WILL:**

* Own the end-to-end technical integration of our API-driven platform into each client's ecosystem
* Troubleshoot recurring technical issues and drive escalations through to resolution
* Manage a portfolio of enterprise accounts, tracking API usage to protect retention, growth, and satisfaction
* Partner with Customer Success Managers and Engineering to deliver a strong client experience
* Design and continuously improve customer onboarding processes
* Identify new technology partnerships and integration opportunities that expand our ecosystem
* Guide customers through expectation-setting conversations that build long-term trust
* Support escalated tickets alongside the broader support team

  

**WHAT WE NEED YOU TO BRING TO THE TABLE:**

* 4+ years of previous experience working as a Technical Account Manager, Integrations Consultant, , or similar technical client-facing role
* Experience owning API integrations end-to-end for enterprise-level accounts
* Demonstrated ability to successfully handle the demands of Enterprise accounts, including complex stakeholder management
* Proven experience with SaaS based products
* High level of problem-solving attitude in a troubleshooting environment
* Excellent written communication skills with the ability to explain complex topics in easily understood and concise language to both technical and non-technical professionals
* Stay calm, patient, and professional while managing high-stakes customer relationships
* Analytical understanding with a high focus on data-driven decision-making

  

**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Learning budget and LinkedIn Learning
* Competitive salaries & 401(k) plan w/match
* Medical, dental, & life insurance
* Flexible PTO
* Mental health support with Nilo.health

**WHY YOU SHOULD WORK FOR US:**

* **The right attitude:** modern methods and a diverse, creative workspace with an open and international culture
* **Everyone for the product:** Together we create a flexible, highly scalable product with state-of-the-art technologies. We can only succeed if everyone works as a team
* **Healthy Growth:** Growing our company means growing everyone in the team. We love to share knowledge and learn
* **A great environment:** Flexible and family-friendly environment, bright and easily accessible offices, modern software and hardware
* **High flexibility degree:** Prefer to work early or late at night? Do you have to pick up your children from kindergarten? Do you prefer working abroad? We believe in results and motivated employees

  

**Do you want this job?**

We'd love to hear from you! Apply directly via the form below.

We do not make employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religious belief, ethnic origin, nationality, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state, or federal laws or prohibited by company policy. As an employer we strive for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibit harassment of any kind.*

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
The Scale Marketing Account Manager serves as the lead point of contact for all account management matters, providing ongoing and proactive client service and acts as the internal champion of assigned accounts.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Maintain an in-depth knowledge of client business, current KPIs and historical activity
* Collaborate with lead Partner/Account Strategists to identify and grow new opportunities for assigned accounts
* Clearly communicate the progress of monthly/quarterly initiatives to internal and external stakeholders
* Anticipate problems/challenges and present ideas to address before they become performance issues
* Prepare reports on account performance prior to weekly/monthly client meetings
* Be the day-to-day contact for key client personnel, always ready to assist with challenging client requests or to escalate issues as needed
* Manage budgets and timelines, flagging any changes of scope with time and/or budget implications
* Work with finance team to provide ongoing financial coordination, media reconciliation, client invoicing and account tracking.
* Work with data team to forecast and track key assigned account metrics (e.g. monthly/quarterly sales results and annual forecasts)
* Collaborate with in-house creative team members to ensure projects are completed and in line with media launch dates.
* Be curious and forward-thinking, understanding trends with the ability to articulate how they will affect client business
* Be a pleaser without being a pushover.
* Collaborate on market/competitive research and landscape client business category
* Manage onboarding process for new clients (Marketing Services Agreements, AOR letters, credit applications, etc.)
* Participate in planning topline account strategy outlines including suggested media tactics, budget recommendations, target customer focus, etc.
* Own the scheduling of Internal Strategy Meetings & client strategy presentation meetings
* Build detailed strategy presentations with media buys and client presentation meeting agendas
* Work with Media Planner/Buyers to manage media RFPs and organize submissions for internal review; communicating with media vendors to refine proposals and identify new opportunities
* Obtain order acceptance, contract confirmation documents and airchecks/proof of performance from every media partner to ensure schedules are running properly
* Liaison with outside Media Vendors to ensure schedules run cleanly, make goods are processed, and demonstrates sound judgement when considering solutions to impression delivery challenges
* Own communication with Creative department for assigned accounts including submission of deliverables required and obtaining client approvals
* Own communication with Digital department for assigned accounts including dissemination of IOs, budget guidelines and campaign KPIs
* Other tasks as necessary for assigned clients to ensure excellent customer service

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3+ years of client account management
* Agency side experience working with both traditional and digital media channels preferred
* Curiosity, Honesty, Integrity, Respect for Peers and the Process
* Ego-less: We all pitch in where needed to get the job done.
* We Treat Our Clients Businesses Like They Are Our Own

**About Scale**
---------------

Scale Marketing is a collective of professionals who bring unique business and media experience together to drive client success.

We dive into our client’s customer data and historic media buys to optimize strategy. We buy media strategically and efficiently, and we produce creative work designed to meet specific KPIs. With robust data and analytics expertise, Scale is constantly testing, analyzing, updating, and optimizing.

We attribute our success to the way we treat our clients and each other, and we are always looking for subject matter experts to join our team.

Proud to be awarded designation by Crain’s Chicago Business as one of the 2021 Best Places to Work in Chicago.

We have been supplying high-quality cold heading steel wire to our customers for over 100 years! * Maintain close relationship with outside sales.
* Support Outside sales and accounting with pricing or invoice issues.

We’re Dealer Tire, a family-owned, international distributor of tires and parts established in 1918 in Cleveland, OH. We’re laser focused on helping the world’s largest and most trusted auto manufacturers grow their tire business—in fact, we’ve sold more than 60 million tires to date. We’re a thriving company, and we’re looking for driven individuals to join our team. That’s where you come in!

$71,196 - $88,842

**Targeted Annual Commission:**

$24,000

**What’s In It For You**

We have a dedicated team of more than 120 passionate and innovative Outside Account Managers throughout the United States. Here are a few reasons why we’d make a great team:

* **Career Opportunity****.** We are a high growth company with excellent opportunities for advancement. Our training and development programs prepare you for long-term career growth.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**At Poka, we're changing how the world's industrial teams work — capturing the knowledge of their best people and putting it in every operator's hands.**

**Our connected worker platform is purpose-built for manufacturing and the wider industrial world, with industrial AI inside the shift, not on top of it. The result: frontline performance that becomes compounding knowledge and measurable impact — every shift, every site, every region.**

**We're proud to support global leaders like Nestlé, Bosch, Mars, and Danone across 3,000+ sites in 70+ countries. And as a fast-growing part of the IFS family, you'll join a team whose daily work directly shapes the platform behind how modern manufacturing gets done.**

**Customer Success Manager, Manufacturing**

At Poka, we're changing how the world's industrial teams work, capturing the knowledge of their best people and putting it in every operator's hands.

Our connected worker platform is purpose-built for manufacturing and the wider industrial world, with industrial AI inside the shift, not on top of it. The result: frontline performance that becomes compounding knowledge and measurable impact, every shift, every site, every region.

We're proud to support global leaders like Nestlé, Bosch, Mars, and Danone across 3,000+ sites in 70+ countries. And as a fast-growing part of the IFS family, you'll join a team whose daily work directly shapes the platform behind how modern manufacturing gets done.

You've spent time on the floor. You know what an unplanned stop or a rushed changeover really costs. Now you get to help the plants using Poka fix those problems at scale.

**Role overview**

As a Customer Success Manager, you'll look after a portfolio of manufacturing customers and help them get real, measurable value from Poka. You'll guide sites from early adoption through to renewal, help their teams apply Poka to their CI and TPM work, and become the person they call when they want to do more.

You'll report to our Director of Customer Success and work alongside experienced Senior CSMs who'll help you ramp up. Your manufacturing background is the foundation. We'll teach you the SaaS side.

**What you'll be doing**

* Manage a portfolio of manufacturing accounts, driving adoption, engagement and ROI across the customer lifecycle
* Build relationships with operators, supervisors, CI leads and plant managers, and grow your confidence with senior stakeholders over time
* Help customers apply Poka to their CI and TPM initiatives using our library of Playbooks and proven use cases
* Run regular check-ins and business reviews, tracking usage and the operational KPIs that matter to each site
* Spot when a customer is stuck, get to the root cause, and work with them on practical fixes
* Flag expansion opportunities to Account Managers and support renewal conversations
* Work closely with Onboarding, Support, Product and Sales so customers get a joined-up experience
* Use AI tools in your daily work, from summarising calls to preparing business reviews and analysing usage data
* Share ideas to improve CS team tools and workflows
* Travel to customer sites up to 20% of the time (typically 2 visits per quarter)

**What you bring**

* 4+ years in a manufacturing environment, in roles such as Production Supervisor, CI Specialist, Process or Quality Engineer, Maintenance Planner or Operations Coordinator
* Working knowledge of Lean, CI or TPM (a Green Belt or similar is an asset)
* Experience training people, leading improvement events or supporting a new system rollout on site
* Comfort with operational data like OEE, downtime and scrap, and the ability to explain what the numbers mean
* Solid organisation skills and the ability to keep several accounts moving at once
* Curiosity about technology and AI. You've already tried AI tools at work and want to get better with them
* Clear written and verbal communication in English (French is a bonus)
* Willingness to travel up to 20%

No SaaS experience? That's fine. If you understand how a plant runs and you enjoy helping people get better at their jobs, we'd love to hear from you, even if you don't tick every box.

**Why Poka**

You'll join a team that knows manufacturing from the inside, with Senior CSMs to learn from and a clear path toward Senior and Enterprise CSM roles as you grow. Your work shows up on the floor: in faster onboarding, fewer repeat problems and frontline teams that keep what they know.

**What we offer:**

* Scale-up energy with huge backing and a global yet close-knit team.
* Generous vacation policy, additional paid days, and charity day.
* Hybrid work policy - Employees who live within a 40 km radius of our Québec City office or a 15 km radius of our Montréal office are required to work in-office two days per week.
* 100% remote work if you do not live within the radiuses mentioned above.
* A truly flexible schedule that allows you to adapt your work hours.
* Group insurance from day one (dental, medication, disability, travel, etc.) with employer contributions, including access to telemedicine and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
* A retirement savings plan with employer contributions.
* A MacBook Pro and a $500 home office allowance upon hiring.
* A generous annual learning and development budget to support your growth, plus the tools and opportunities you need to keep progressing in your career.

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.  
  
We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.  
  
Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.  
  
At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.  
  
Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

* A pro-active and capable of thinking outside the box to generate leads.

**Bonus points for…**

* Experience in the travel industry.

* Bring a curiosity for tech and AI—especially in how it can be used creatively to improve workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and drive efficiency in your day-to-day sales process.

new_jobs.description:
Description:**Innovative Dining Group (IDG) is seeking a detail-oriented and creative MARKETING COORDINATOR** **to support marketing initiatives across our growing portfolio of restaurants.**

This hands-on role will help keep our digital presence accurate and up to date, support social media and content development, conduct competitive and industry research, and assist with restaurant-level marketing needs. The ideal candidate is curious, organized, resourceful, and excited to learn, with a strong interest in hospitality, marketing, social media, and emerging technology.

**This position is based full-time in our corporate office located at 9200 Sunset Blvd., West Hollywood, CA 90069.**

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES** include but are not limited to:

**Digital + Website**

* Conduct regular audits of all brand and restaurant websites to ensure hours, menus, reservation links, contact information, private dining details, photography, and copy are accurate and up to date.
* Audit Google Business Profiles for accuracy, including hours, categories, links, photos, menus, and other key business information.
* Ensure restaurant names and business information are consistent across Google, Apple Maps, Yelp, Tripadvisor, and other relevant platforms.
* Conduct regular Yelp and Tripadvisor audits to identify inaccurate information, outdated imagery, or other content requiring updates.
* Test SevenRooms reservation links across websites, social media, Google, and other customer-facing channels to ensure links are active and functioning properly.
* Review the mobile experience across all websites and flag formatting, functionality, or content issues.
* Set up and maintain enterprise Canva accounts across locations and provide basic training and support to GMs as needed.
* Audit restaurant menus across digital channels to ensure they accurately match current approved menu PDFs.
* Audit email signup forms across all websites to ensure they are functioning properly and capturing customer information as intended.

**Social Media**

* Conduct regular social media audits to ensure account information, links, contact details, and other profile information are accurate and up to date.
* Monitor Instagram and TikTok for trending sounds, formats, and content opportunities relevant to BOA, Sushi Roku, Katana, and other IDG brands.
* Identify and organize relevant user-generated content, including screenshots and creator handles, for potential reposting by individual restaurant locations.
* Research emerging restaurant content trends and formats and present 5–10 relevant content ideas each week.

**Restaurant + Operations Marketing**

* Maintain an accurate inventory of restaurant uniforms, including updating tracking spreadsheets and organizing uniform storage areas.
* Develop and maintain a master reference of restaurant hours, happy hours, brunch and lunch offerings, private dining capacities, parking and valet information, and other key guest-facing details.
* Assist Marketing Manager with planning, production, organization, and coordination of the Holiday Cookbook.
* Support restaurant-level marketing needs and projects as assigned, helping ensure brand standards and marketing materials are consistently executed across locations.

**Competitive Research + Industry Trends**

* Conduct ongoing competitive research using Bluenote and other relevant sources to identify trends and opportunities across the restaurant and hospitality industry.
* Monitor competitors and relevant brands for new restaurant openings, launches, collaborations, events, promotions, partnerships, and creative marketing initiatives.
* Prepare a weekly Friday recap highlighting the most relevant trends, ideas, and competitive activity for the marketing team.

**Technology + AI**

* Research emerging marketing technology, AI tools, platforms, and resources that could improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the Marketing department.
* Assist in auditing recurring marketing tasks and workflows to identify redundancies, opportunities for automation, and areas where AI can improve efficiency.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

**MANAGER, STARLINK CUSTOMER SUCCESS (ASIA-PACIFIC & OCEANIA)**

Starlink provides high-speed, low-latency internet to customers around the world. Our enterprise resellers bring Starlink to businesses across a wide range of markets and use cases.

As the **Manager, Starlink Customer Success (Asia-Pacific & Oceania),** you will lead the team responsible for our enterprise reseller business across Asia-Pacific, including Australia, New Zealand, and the Pacific Islands. The region spans a broad set of countries, time zones, regulatory environments, and customer needs, with resellers often operating across multiple markets. You will manage Customer Success Managers, Leads, and Specialists and be accountable for the performance and growth of the existing book.

Your team is responsible for growing revenue with existing customers, expanding their use of Starlink, and maintaining strong commercial relationships. Across Asia-Pacific and Oceania, turning an opportunity into revenue can depend on product availability, capacity, local billing requirements, regulatory readiness, logistics, and activation. You will help the team navigate those constraints while keeping the focus on growth.

This is a player-coach role. You will set clear priorities, coach and develop your team, and hold a high bar for performance. You will also stay close to key customers and step into the most important growth opportunities, renewals, payment issues, and escalations. We expect you to know your book, understand where the next opportunities and risks are, and keep a geographically distributed team focused on the right work.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead, hire, and develop a team of Customer Success Managers, Leads, and Specialists across Asia-Pacific and Oceania
* Grow revenue across an existing book of enterprise resellers
* Help the team identify and close opportunities for customers to expand their use of Starlink across hardware, service, data, and products
* Build hardware and service forecasts that leadership can rely on, with a clear view of opportunities and risks across markets
* Develop a clear view of where demand is growing across the region and what is required to turn that demand into revenue
* Work through billing, payment, regulatory, capacity, logistics, product availability, and activation issues when they are blocking growth
* Partner with Sales, Channel Sales, Finance, Tax, Engineering, Operations, Support, and Logistics to move customer opportunities forward
* Align closely with regional Sales and Channel Sales teams so resellers receive a clear and consistent message across markets
* Identify problems that repeat across countries and work with the right teams to solve them at scale
* Build strong coverage and operating discipline across a team working with customers in widely separated time zones
* Stay close enough to the work to know when to coach, when to step in, and when to let the team run independently

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
* 6+ years in customer success, account management, sales, or another commercial role for a technical product
* 3+ years owning and growing a book of existing customers, with direct responsibility for revenue, retention, or expansion
* 2+ years of direct people management

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**

* Strong track record of growing revenue within existing enterprise accounts
* Experience leading a commercial book across Asia-Pacific and Oceania
* Experience managing customers across geographically distributed markets with different regulatory, billing, logistics, and product requirements
* Commercial mindset with the ability to understand a customer's business, find opportunities, and turn them into revenue
* Experience leading geographically distributed teams responsible for customer and revenue goals
* Strong financial understanding, including pricing, billing, collections, and payment terms
* Experience working through complex customer issues across logistics, regulatory requirements, capacity, billing, or operations
* Ability to prioritize across a large region and distinguish the highest-value commercial opportunities from operational noise
* Clear and direct communicator who can work effectively across different countries, cultures, and customer environments
* Experience in telecommunications, satellite, connectivity, networking, or another technical industry

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Must be willing to work onsite five days per week
* Must be willing to travel regularly throughout Asia-Pacific and Oceania and to other SpaceX locations
* Must be available for early mornings, evenings, and occasional weekends to support customers across regional time zones and commercial deadlines

Pickleball TV is looking for a Social Media Manager to own its Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube channels, with YouTube a key priority across both long-form and Shorts. You'll also travel to select pickleball events to capture content on site and build relationships across the pickleball community.

This role is onsite and located in Santa Monica, CA.

**In this role, you willâ€¦**

**Develop Strategy**

* Build and own a distinct strategy for each channel â€” audience, content pillars, formats, cadence, and growth tactics.
* Set quarterly plans for each platform and plan for events, programming moments, campaigns, and sponsor deliverables.
* Identify growth opportunities, such as new series, formats, and creator collaborations, and bring recommendations to the Head of Social.
* Track performance, report weekly and monthly to the Head of Social, and adjust based on what's working.
  

**Create & Publish Content**

* Concept and create social-first content and series: player features, highlights, skills content, trends, and behind-the-scenes.

**Manage & Grow YouTube**

* Own Pickleball TV's YouTube strategy across long-form and Shorts, growing subscribers, views, and watch time.

* Travel to select events to plan and capture on-site content and publish from the ground.
* Manage community engagement across all channels, including responding to comments and DMs and joining trending pickleball conversations.
* Run UGC sourcing, including securing rights and credit.
* Build relationships with players, creators, and event partners.
* Stay ahead of trends and platform changes on TikTok, Reels, and Shorts, and move quickly on the right ones.
  

**Lead the Team**

* Manage and develop the production coordinator; brief and review video edits for short- and long-form content.
* Set up workflows so editing and publishing keep moving while you're traveling.

* 3-5 years in social media, ideally in sports, live events, or entertainment, with a track record of growing channels

* Knowledge of pickleball a strong plus

new_jobs.description:
**SALARY RANGE**

$30 - $32 per hour.

**GENERAL DESCRIPTION**

The Family Life Coordinator keeps the department organized, connected, and moving forward. Working closely with Family Life leadership and program managers, this position coordinates shared priorities, upcoming programs, and operational needs across all Family Life functions. These include Tikvah, Athletics, Youth Recreation, Camp, Dance, Musical Theater, Playdate, Maccabi initiatives, and family events.

The Coordinator gathers information from managers, brings the team together, tracks responsibilities and deadlines, and follows up to ensure plans move into action. The role anticipates needs, identifies gaps, and brings timely updates and requests for decisions to leadership. Program managers retain responsibility for program strategy, budgets, and staff supervision; the Coordinator supports execution and accountability through clear organization and consistent follow-through.

This is a highly collaborative position requiring initiative, sound judgment, and confidence in working with colleagues at different levels. It combines department coordination, hands-on program support, customer service, and routine administration. The position works on-site five days per week and moves regularly between the office and active program spaces.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

##### **Department Coordination and Follow-Through**

* Maintain a shared department calendar and action tracker covering upcoming programs, launches, events, key deadlines, responsible staff, and operational needs.
* Check in regularly with program managers to understand what is coming up, what support is needed, and where plans require coordination across areas.
* Organize and help facilitate Family Life operations meetings; gather agenda items, document decisions and action items, and follow up on commitments.
* Prompt managers and leadership for needed information, approvals, and decisions; provide concise progress updates and flag delays or unresolved issues early.
* Coordinate shared staffing, space, equipment, and communication needs; help resolve scheduling conflicts and bring resource decisions to the appropriate manager.
* Help translate agreed priorities into practical next steps and coordinate with Facilities, Marketing, Account Services, and other internal partners to move work forward.

##### **Program Readiness and Operations**

* Coordinate operational preparation for Tikvah, Athletics, Youth Recreation, Camp, and other Family Life programs, including schedules, space reservations, staffing logistics, supplies, and equipment.
* Use practical readiness checklists to confirm that rosters, participant information, materials, family communications, and staff instructions are available before programs begin.
* Ensure coaches, instructors, seasonal staff, and other program team members receive timely schedules, updates, and the resources needed to deliver programs.
* Coordinate training logistics and help managers arrange coverage for open shifts, breaks, or absences; communicate coverage gaps promptly.

##### **Hands-On Program Support**

* Provide an active on-site presence during programs and events, supporting check-in and check-out, attendance, participant transitions, setup, breakdown, and family questions.
* Step into program activities or temporary coverage as needed, including recreation, athletics, camp, and customer service duties appropriate to training and experience.

* BA or BS degree required, or equivalent combination of experience and education.
* At least 2 years of experience in youth programing.
* Salesforce experience a plus.
* Outstanding customer service skills and experience working in a customer-centric organization.
* Experience and ability in designing, creating managing and implementing schedules, reports, and operational plans.
* Outstanding computer skills, including advanced skills in MS Office and the ability to learn new business software programs.
* Experience working with children age 3-13 Working knowledge of child development is a plus.

* Excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Must be well-organized with strong attention to detail.
* Ability to work as part of a team and effectively engage and coordinate with various stakeholders (both staff and clients).
* Ability to handle multiple projects, setting appropriate priorities, and effective time management while ensuring that all deadlines are honored.

They had an idea: bring Chicago’s local restaurant culture inside the office to sell food. It was an immediate hit. When they discovered people from other companies sneaking into their office, they knew they were on to something.  
  
Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities with over 100 million meals served and continue to grow rapidly.  
  
Powered by technology and a network of 3,500+ restaurants, we feed hungry people at work through a platform of unique food programs located within companies, office buildings, hospitals, schools, distribution centers, and more. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. new_jobs.description:
**About RugsUSA**

Founded in 1998, Rugs USA has grown into a trusted online destination for high-quality rugs that bring style and value to every space. Today, we have a growing portfolio of home and lifestyle brands, all with a shared commitment to making it easier for people to create spaces they love. Our portfolio includes Annie Selke, known for thoughtfully designed home goods rooted in quality craftsmanship; and nuLOOM, which makes design-forward rugs accessible at a range of price points.

We’re passionate about the difference the right pieces can make in a space, so we’ve built close relationships with designers, artisans, and factories around the world. Those partnerships help us keep our model simple, offer great value, and bring customers a wide range of styles.

Whether someone is refreshing a room or starting from scratch, we want the process to feel easy and inspiring. Our curated assortment gives customers the pieces they need to bring their vision for home to life, whatever their style or price point.

**Position Overview**

The Ecommerce Account Manager is responsible for managing the day-to-day activities, support needs, and growth opportunities for a portfolio of wholesale and marketplace ecommerce accounts. This role serves as the primary point of contact for assigned web-based customers, ensuring they have accurate product information, pricing, imagery, specifications, and the tools needed to successfully market and sell our products online.

The Ecommerce Account Manager will work closely with customers, Codarus representatives, and the Annie Selke Inside Sales Representative team to provide timely information, resolve issues, support account growth, and deliver reporting and insights that drive business results.

**Essential Job Functions**

Manage the daily operational needs of multiple wholesale and marketplace ecommerce accounts.

* Serve as the primary contact for customers and reps regarding product information, pricing, promotional calendar, imagery, specifications, inventory inquiries, and account support.
* Respond promptly to customer questions and requests, coordinating with internal teams as needed to provide solutions.
* Monitor account performance and identify opportunities to improve sales, product visibility, and overall business growth.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, reps, and key stakeholders.
* Act as the main point of contact for Codarus representatives and the AS ISR team and/or Marketplace account managers regarding ecommerce account information and support.
* Prepare and distribute reports, sales updates, product information, and other requested business insights.
* Coordinate new product launches, assortment updates, pricing changes, and content updates across assigned accounts.
* Ensure account data and product information remain accurate and up to date across customer platforms.
* Escalate and help resolve customer issues, content discrepancies, and operational challenges.
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, Operations, and Product teams to support customer needs and business objectives.

**You Have**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferred.
* 2+ years of experience in ecommerce, account management, customer support, sales operations, or a related field.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting tools.
* Experience working with ecommerce marketplaces, wholesale accounts, product content, and digital assets is preferred.
* Ability to analyze information, identify opportunities, and recommend solutions.
* Self-motivated with a proactive, customer-focused approach.

**Your Life and Career at RugsUSA**

* A culture that promotes a healthy work/life balance
* Benefits package offered to all eligible full-time employees (including medical, dental, vision, PTO, 401(k)
* Exposure to career advancement opportunities across all departments
* Generous employee discount that can be used across our house of brands!

  
**The pay range for this role is:**  
75,000 - 90,000 USD per year(Manhattan Office)

new_jobs.title: Enterprise Technical Account Manager, AMER
new_jobs.description:
**ABOUT TALON.ONE:**

  

Talon.One is the most powerful incentives engine that unifies loyalty, promotions and gamification into one holistic platform. Backed by enterprise-grade security and scalability, Talon.One empowers companies to build personalized, profitable promotions and loyalty programs using any data.

Today, over 250 of the world's most-loved brands including Adidas, Sephora and Carlsberg work with Talon.One to drive deeper engagement and lasting loyalty with their customers.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

Join our team as an Enterprise Technical Account Manager at Talon.One, where you'll play a key role in driving the success of our API-first promotion engine for our enterprise clients across the growing Americas region. You'll take ownership of the technical integration process, ensuring our platform fits seamlessly into each client's ecosystem. As the technical lead for your portfolio, you'll proactively monitor API usage, resolve recurring issues, and manage escalations in close collaboration with our Engineering and Customer Success teams.

You'll lead onboarding design, manage expectations, and deliver consistent value that boosts retention, growth, and satisfaction. In this strategic role, you'll also explore new tech partnerships and integration opportunities that expand our ecosystem and unlock more value for our customers.

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM:**

Our global team of 15+ Technical Account Managers is spread across the world, including EMEA, US, and APAC. We always strive for a seamless client onboarding and bug-free integration, while balancing ever-changing client requests on a daily basis. Our team works closely with Customer Success Managers and the development team, enabling us to act as consultants to all parties involved in the client onboarding journey. Ultimately, handling expectations related to the integration of our platform is where we drive value for our clients & our company.

Our team is defined by our commitment to mutual support and our dedication to deep problem-solving. These qualities are essential in future teammates in order for us to continue building on our strengths.

The estimated total compensation for this role is $115,500, though actual compensation may vary depending on factors such as relevant experience, skills, qualifications, certifications, and location. The salary range is subject to change and may be adjusted at any time. For this role, you must be located within commuting distance of one of our US hubs: New York, Chicago, San Francisco, or Boston.

  

**ONCE YOU ARE HERE YOU WILL:**

* Own the end-to-end technical integration of our API-driven platform into each client's ecosystem
* Troubleshoot recurring technical issues and drive escalations through to resolution
* Manage a portfolio of enterprise accounts, tracking API usage to protect retention, growth, and satisfaction
* Partner with Customer Success Managers and Engineering to deliver a strong client experience
* Design and continuously improve customer onboarding processes
* Identify new technology partnerships and integration opportunities that expand our ecosystem
* Guide customers through expectation-setting conversations that build long-term trust
* Support escalated tickets alongside the broader support team

  

**WHAT WE NEED YOU TO BRING TO THE TABLE:**

* 4+ years of previous experience working as a Technical Account Manager, Integrations Consultant, , or similar technical client-facing role
* Experience owning API integrations end-to-end for enterprise-level accounts
* Demonstrated ability to successfully handle the demands of Enterprise accounts, including complex stakeholder management
* Proven experience with SaaS based products
* High level of problem-solving attitude in a troubleshooting environment
* Excellent written communication skills with the ability to explain complex topics in easily understood and concise language to both technical and non-technical professionals
* Stay calm, patient, and professional while managing high-stakes customer relationships
* Analytical understanding with a high focus on data-driven decision-making

  

**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Learning budget and LinkedIn Learning
* Competitive salaries & 401(k) plan w/match
* Medical, dental, & life insurance
* Flexible PTO
* Mental health support with Nilo.health

new_jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you.

**Role Overview:**

The Sales Operations Data & Systems Lead architects the technical foundation and data strategy powering our global sales organization. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Sales Operations, you will eliminate seller friction by owning GTM tech stack management, building high-integrity workflows, leading continuous Salesforce data cleanup initiatives, and deploying AI-driven solutions. You will directly fuel top-of-funnel growth by designing data pipelines for sourcing and enriching new accounts. As the primary steward of our GTM technology, you will architect robust reporting frameworks to ensure the Salesforce ecosystem remains a scalable, well-governed system of record that drives revenue productivity.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

#### **1. Systems Engineering & Tech Stack Management**

* Architecture: Lead the technical configuration and governance of Salesforce and the broader GTM stack (Openprise, Clay, etc.)
* Automation & AI: Architect and maintain advanced automations using AI to reduce manual work and streamline account sourcing, enrichment, and routing
* GTM Tools Management: Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of GTM tools, from vendor selection and integration to user provisioning and ticket-based troubleshooting

#### **2. Data Strategy & Governance**

* Automated Data Integrity: Build scalable cleansing, deduplication, and enrichment workflows across all GTM data sources
* Governance Frameworks: Establish policies to improve data quality, governance, and cross-platform alignment
* ICP Signal Capture: Partner with Marketing and Sales to translate the Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) into technical signals to capture high-quality, actionable data for outbound teams

#### **3. Process Optimization**

* Friction Reduction: Redesign Opportunity management, approval flows, and renewal/expansion handoffs to increase seller productivity
* Change Management: Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT), document SOPs, and conduct training to ensure high adoption of GTM tools and Salesforce system enhancements

#### **4. Insights & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Technical Advisory: Serve as the Sales Operations team's Subject Matter Expert (SME) for data transformation, translating data into business solutions for stakeholders
* Performance Metrics: Develop dashboards and KPIs to track system health, data quality trends, and the ROI of automation initiatives

**Sales Planning Data Projects: Cross-functional GTM leadership to execute data projects focused on TAM enrichment, white-space analysis, and strategic account segmentation.**

**Required Skills and Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce administration experience in a complex, fast-paced environment (certifications a plus)
* Highly preferred experience with Openprise, Clay, and/or Tray.io
* Experience managing sales data tech stack
* Experience administering and implementing AI-powered tools or workflows in a Go-to-Market Operations / Sales Operations context
* Strong proficiency in data analytics and reporting (Looker, Tableau, advanced Excel, Python and/or other advanced tools preferred)
* Proven experience gathering business requirements and translating them into well-architected system solutions
* Strong production support mindset, with the ability to balance urgent issues against longer-term platform improvements
* Excellent project management and communication skills

  

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $94,000 and $147,000/year, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $106,000 and $151,000/year (including bonus or commission).Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

We’re an industry leader with a startup mentality. We take what we do seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Creating and collaborating to transform the sound of streaming, content, and culture. Come join us, and let the world** ***feel*** **your work.**

As a **Digital Customer Success Manager**, you will play a crucial role in our US Enterprise team. Your role will be to redefine how we support and scale our mid-market Customers through a sophisticated inside, digital-first motion.

This role is the engine behind our one-to-many customer success strategy, ensuring that hundreds of production companies, broadcasters, and brands across the Americas are successfully soundtracking their stories. By blending data-driven insights with a passion for creative workflows, you will ensure our users are fully adopting our library of 55,000+ tracks. You will collaborate closely with Growth Managers to identify growth leads and work with our CRM, Finance, and Ops teams to scale our workflows and keep the engine running smoothly.

**Your key responsibilities include:**

* Drive high-volume customer adoption and retention through automated, digital-led engagement strategies and one-to-many programs.
* Act as a digital advisor for a diverse portfolio, helping creators from brands to digital publishers maximize the value of our music and sound effects.
* Be the face of Epidemic Sound to this customer cohort as required, but adopt a digital first scaled motion to take customers through phased journeys of adoption, retention, development etc.
* Analyze usage data and engagement metrics to proactively identify churn risks and implement scalable mitigation tactics.
* Partner with Growth Managers to highlight expansion opportunities within your portfolio, directly impacting our revenue growth.

new_jobs.title: Shipping & Operations Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Location:** Upper East Side, Manhattan, NYC.

**Hours:** Full-time, five days a week, 10:00 – 6:00 (37.5 hours/week). Saturday availability is required.

**Salary:** $50,000

**Reporting to:** Gallery Manager

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a reliable, meticulous and proactive [insert job title here] to join our New York team. This is a hands-on role, and shipping, logistics and operations are the core of it: packing and dispatching rare books and works on paper, handling couriers and customs documentation, keeping detailed shipping logs, moving and caring for stock, preparing for book fairs, and ensuring that the gallery runs smoothly day to day.

The position is entry-level, but we are looking for someone to take real ownership of it. Shipping and operations in New York will be this person's department to run, and there is room to grow as this side of the business expands.

At least one year's experience in shipping, logistics or operations is preferred. Short of that, we will consider candidates who can demonstrate a real interest in the work and a willingness to learn it properly.

**Duties will include, but are not limited to:**

**Shipping & Receiving:**

* Package and prepare books, prints, artworks, and other items for both international and domestic shipping.
* Coordinate with the UK shipping team to prepare shipping labels and supporting documentation for US and international deliveries.
* Liaise with couriers and postal service providers to ensure timely and cost-effective deliveries.
* Deliver goods locally between Peter Harrington New York, bookstores, galleries, auction houses, trade fairs, and clients.
* Log incoming and outgoing goods and maintain accurate, well-organized records.
* Assist with the organization and setup of book fairs, including staffing arrangements and packing and unpacking book fair trunks.
* Apply protective coverings and ensure the appropriate care of incoming and existing stock.

**Logistics & Compliance:**

* Manage accounts and relationships with couriers, freight forwarders and postal providers; obtain quotes and ensure deliveries are timely and cost-effective.

* Arrange transit insurance, ensure values are declared correctly, and handle claims for loss or damage.
* Track consignments through to delivery, resolving delays, customs holds and missing parcels.
* Monitor shipping costs against budget and recommend improvements to carriers, materials or process.
* Maintain and improve the department's procedures and documentation so that shipping runs consistently and can be picked up by others when needed.

**Operations & Facilities:**

* Take day-to-day responsibility for the smooth running of the New York premises.
* Schedule and oversee facilities projects from start to finish with minimal supervision, liaising with contractors and building management.

* Manage the layout and upkeep of office and gallery space: furniture, equipment, storage and removals.
* Maintain inventory of office, kitchen and packing supplies, reordering proactively so that nothing runs out mid-shipment.
* Act as the first point of contact for IT issues on site, liaising with the IT department in London and with external vendors.
* Run occasional business-related errands as required.

**Bookfairs & Events:**

* Prepare stock for fairs: packing and unpacking trunks, preparing lists, and ensuring shipments arrive on schedule.
* Assist with the organisation and set-up of book fairs, including staffing arrangements and stand build.
* Assist with the set-up and coordination of gallery events and other ad hoc activities, liaising with venues and external suppliers.

**Essential Skills and Experience:**

* Previous experience handling, packing, or shipping valuable, fragile, or collectible items.
* Stellar time management skills.
* Meticulous attention to detail.
* Initiative and a proactive approach to responsibilities.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, along with strong numeracy.
* Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels.
* Professionalism and confidence when interacting with a diverse range of clients and colleagues.
* Effective team player with a collaborative approach.

### ***This job is being posted on behalf of a food service design consulting company, located in Norcross, GA.***

### **Position Summary**

The Administrative Coordinator supports the operational and financial management of Camacho projects by maintaining accurate, timely, and complete information across monday.com and BigTime Software. This position is responsible for the daily administration of monday.com, including project onboarding, scheduling, data management, employee records and onboarding, billing support, analytics, and accounting-related information.

The Administrative Coordinator reports directly to the CEO and works closely with the Production and Sales teams to ensure that project, client, staffing, timekeeping, and financial data remain aligned. The role will also support Camacho's phased incorporation of NetSuite CRM and, in the future, NetSuite accounting with monday.com.

Success in this role requires exceptional attention to detail, strong follow-through, comfort working with business software and data, and the ability to coordinate information among multiple departments while maintaining confidentiality.

### **Monday.com Administration**

* Serve as the day-to-day administrator and primary internal resource for monday.com.

procedures.

* Monitor the system daily for incomplete, inconsistent, duplicate, or overdue information and work with responsible employees to correct issues promptly.
* Maintain system organization, data integrity, naming conventions, user access, documentation, and change records.
* Coordinate with the Accounting Manager and company leadership regarding requested system changes, new workflows, reporting needs, and process improvements.
* Complete assigned monday.com training modules and remain current on the features used by Camacho. Training will be provided through monday.com's software training

modules.

### **Project Onboarding and Scheduling**

* Set up new clients, opportunities, projects, phases, tasks, budgets, schedules, milestones, team assignments, and required project information in monday.com.

* Enter, review, reconcile, and maintain accurate client, contact, project, employee, time, billing, and accounting-related data across authorized systems.

* Assist with future NetSuite accounting integration with monday.com as assigned by the Accounting Manager.
* Identify discrepancies between monday.com, BigTime, NetSuite, and supporting records; research the cause and coordinate corrections.
* Follow established controls for data entry, approvals, access, retention, confidentiality, and system changes.
* Maintain written procedures, templates, data dictionaries, and training materials for the systems and processes assigned to this position.

### **Employee Records and Onboarding**

* Set up new employees and approved contractors in monday.com and BigTime, including required profile information, roles, permissions, departments, labor classifications,

cost or billing rates, and project access as authorized.

* Coordinate system onboarding with Accounting, Production, Sales, and other responsible leaders so users receive appropriate access and instructions.
* Update employee information promptly when roles, rates, departments, schedules, reporting relationships, or employment status change.
* Deactivate access and complete assigned system-offboarding steps when an employee or contractor leaves the company.
* Provide routine system guidance and follow up with employees regarding missing updates, incomplete records, overdue tasks, or time-entry issues.

### **BigTime Timekeeping Administration**

* Perform accurate and timely data entry and ongoing data management in BigTime Software, Camacho's current time-tracking system.

* Review timesheet activity for missing, late, incomplete, or incorrectly coded entries and follow up with employees and managers for correction and approval.
* Reconcile project, employee, phase, budget, and time data between BigTime and monday.com and report unresolved differences to the Accounting Manager.
* Prepare recurring and ad hoc time, utilization, project-hours, and exception reports for Accounting, Production, and leadership.

### **Billing and Accounting Support**

* Review project and timekeeping data for completeness before billing and notify the Accounting Manager and project leaders of missing information or discrepancies.
* Prepare billing support, work-in-process information, project summaries, and other documentation requested by the Accounting Manager.
